jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**  

The Project Coordinator provides high\-level administrative and operational support to the assigned business unit, serving as the primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders on all administrative and informational matters. Additionally, this role delivers targeted marketing and project assistance to Sales and Project Managers, while offering cross\-functional backup and collaborative support to other regional offices.


**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Plan and execute department meetings, sales conferences, and vendor presentations as directed, including managing logistics for room bookings, catering, and virtual platforms.
* Document and distribute comprehensive meeting minutes and actionable recap emails to all attendees.
* Coordinate the end\-to\-end onboarding process for new hires in collaboration with Human Resources, ensuring first\-day schedules, itineraries, and team introductions are established in advance.
* Facilitate new hire technical setup by coordinating IT provisioning requests, email setup, building access key fobs, and corporate business cards.
* Monitor Lead Generation platforms for upcoming bid opportunities and manage the distribution of pre\-bid notifications.
* Support the team by preparing prequalification packages, compiling RFP responses, and assembling bid presentation materials.
* Generate and distribute financial and accounting reports for Sales and Project Managers.
Manage corporate event ticket allocations for the Construction Group.

* Demonstrated excellence in customer service, with a strong ability to navigate complex client issues and engineer win\-win solutions.
* High attention to detail with an unwavering commitment to accuracy and timely project delivery.
* Deep understanding of strategies required to maximize the productivity and efficiency of construction and technical teams.
* Strict adherence to data privacy protocols, with a proven ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with total discretion.
Ability to work extended hours or overtime as required by business demands.

***Desired:***

* Associate degree or higher

General knowledge of the construction or service business

jobs.title: Network infrastructure project coordinator
jobs.description:
Network Infrastructure Project Coordinator

**Job Summary**

Join our dynamic team as a Network Infrastructure Project Coordinator, where you will lead the planning, execution, and delivery of complex network infrastructure projects. This role is pivotal in ensuring seamless integration of enterprise IT solutions, optimizing network performance, and supporting organizational growth through innovative infrastructure initiatives. You will coordinate cross\-functional teams, manage project timelines, and communicate effectively with stakeholders to drive successful project outcomes. Your expertise in technical project management and IT infrastructure will empower us to maintain a resilient and scalable network environment.

**Duties**

* Lead end\-to\-end planning and execution of network infrastructure projects, including hardware, software, cloud computing solutions (such as AWS), and enterprise software implementations.
* Develop detailed project schedules using tools like Microsoft Project, Visio, TFS (Team Foundation Server), VersionOne, and Jira to track progress and ensure timely delivery.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams—including IT operations, software development, security, and vendor partners—to gather requirements and define project scope aligned with organizational goals.
* Manage project risks through proactive identification, analysis, and mitigation strategies in accordance with PMBOK (Project Management Body of Knowledge) standards.
* Coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT), test case creation, and validation processes to ensure deliverables meet quality standards before deployment.
* Facilitate Agile methodologies such as Scrum and Kanban for iterative development cycles while integrating Waterfall approaches when necessary for large\-scale implementations.
* Oversee project documentation including SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) artifacts, disaster recovery plans, release management schedules, and IT governance compliance reports.

**Skills**

* Extensive experience managing technical projects within enterprise environments utilizing project management methodologies like PMBOK and Agile frameworks such as Scrum and Kanban.
* Proficiency with project management tools including Microsoft Project, SharePoint, Visio, Jira, TFS, VersionOne, and Microsoft Office suite (Word, Excel).
* Strong knowledge of IT infrastructure components including networking hardware, cloud computing platforms (AWS), databases (SQL Server, Oracle), and enterprise software systems.
* Expertise in requirements gathering, analysis skills, risk management strategies, and stakeholder communication to ensure project alignment with business needs.
* Demonstrated leadership in technical project \& program management supervision with excellent organizational skills and time management abilities.
* Familiarity with SDLC processes for software development and implementation; experience with test\-driven development (TDD) and user acceptance testing procedures.
* Ability to coordinate multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining high standards of quality; skilled in negotiation and team leadership to foster collaboration across diverse teams.
* Knowledge of IT governance principles including disaster recovery planning and compliance standards essential for enterprise solutions implementation.

Join us to be part of a forward\-thinking organization committed to technological excellence! Your expertise will help shape resilient networks that support our mission\-critical operations while advancing your career in a vibrant environment that values innovation and teamwork.

Pay: $30\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:** 

We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Project Coordinator to support both project execution and customer account coordination. This role sits at the center of communication between customers, engineering, production, and sales, ensuring projects move smoothly from concept through delivery.

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast\-paced environment, enjoys managing details, and is skilled at keeping multiple teams aligned. If you are someone who anticipates problems before they arise, communicates clearly, and takes pride in delivering exceptional customer experiences, this role is for you.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Project Coordination

* Attend project and design meetings with customers and internal teams; document key details and action items.
* Review project documentation and drawings to ensure accuracy and completeness.
* Coordinate across engineering, production, and logistics to keep projects on schedule.
* Track manufacturing timelines and project milestones to ensure timely delivery.
* Manage project documentation, approvals, and submittals.
* Monitor project scope and assist with change orders or contract updates when necessary.
* Maintain detailed records of project communications, approvals, and changes.
* Estimate and create scopes of work for new projects.
* Assist with updating actual cost data once production is complete.

Customer and Account Support

* Serve as a key point of contact for customer updates and project progress.
* Build strong relationships with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Assist with preparing proposals, quotes, and project documentation.
* Maintain CRM data and ensure customer records are accurate and up to date.
* Support the sales team with project coordination and follow\-up activities.
* Help track sales pipeline activity and key performance metrics.

What Success Looks Like

* Projects delivered on time, within scope, and with strong customer satisfaction.
* Clear communication across customers, sales, engineering, and operations.
* Organized documentation that protects the company and ensures project clarity.
* Internal teams rely on you to keep projects moving forward.

Qualifications:

Required:

* Bachelor’s degree in business, project management, marketing, communications, or related field preferred.
* 1–3 years of experience in project coordination, sales support, customer service, or a similar role.
* Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and CRM or project management tools.
* A proactive, solutions\-focused mindset.

Pay: From $70,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* AD\&D insurance
* Dental insurance
* Disability insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Opportunities for advancement
* Paid time off
* Referral program
* Vision insurance

New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. jobs.description:
**Grow Healthy**

If you are as passionate about helping those in need as you are about growing your career, consider AltaMed. At AltaMed, your passion for helping others isn’t just welcomed – it’s nurtured, celebrated, and promoted, allowing you to grow while making a meaningful difference. We don’t just serve our communities; we are an integral part of them. By raising the expectations of what a community clinic can deliver, we demonstrate our belief that quality care is for everyone. Our commitment to providing exceptional care, despite any challenges, goes beyond just a job; it’s a calling that drives us forward every day.


**Job Overview**

The Community Health Program Coordinator is responsible for identifying high\-risk patients with poor health outcomes. The role is responsible for program activities such as referral coordination, eligibility checks, and monitoring CHW caseloads. The role will also support data collection and analysis for overall program evaluation. Our organization offers an innovative, evidence\-based health care program that improves health outcomes for low\-income, high\-risk patients using Community Health Workers (CHWs). In this model, CHWs provide structured advocacy, social support, and navigation to high\-risk patients to help them reach their health goals.
 

**Minimum Requirements**

* High School Diploma required.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience with data collection, management, and/or analysis.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience extracting information and exporting data to other applications.
* Experience with the Epic EMR system is a plus.

jobs.title: Seasonal Live Content Correspondents Production Coordinator

This position will be focused on the logistical and operational functions in the capture and real\-time distribution of all LCC generated content. Organizational skills and a strong knowledge of pre\- and post\-production workflows will be invaluable.

* Support 100\+ LCC contractors in the weekly capture and delivery of gameday and event content across the NFL social ecosystem
* Support annual staffing of LCC contributors across all relevant markets w/ associated performance management
* Lead daily communication with LCCs to ensure a seamless production workflow
* Coordinate with the Player Social team to continue to scale LCC content creation opportunities in collaboration with NFL players
* Collaborate closely with other internal stakeholders to execute with LCCs around tentpole events (e.g. Super Bowl, Combine, Draft, Pro Bowl, etc.)
* Stay up to date with industry standards and best practices
* Thoroughly track the LCC program’s activity in partnership with key groups including: publishing of LCC content, consumption / engagement of LCC content, attributable revenue, etc.

* 4\-year degree preferred. BS or BA in content/film/production related field preferred.
* Thorough understanding of social media platforms such as Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, Snapchat, TikTok, etc.
* Advanced understanding of all Microsoft Office programs such as Word, PowerPoint, and Excel
* Thorough understanding of social media platforms such as Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, Snapchat, TikTok, etc.
* Strong working knowledge of the production environment, including both pre and post

* Ability to work non\-traditional hours, including nights and weekends

Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more.

jobs.description:
**Clinical Implementation \& Customer Success Manager**

About MedGEO

MedGEO is a healthcare technology company transforming how procedural care is documented, understood, and optimized at the point of care. Built by clinicians for clinicians, MedGEO combines intelligent automation, AI, and Smart Vision technology to reduce documentation burden, improve data accuracy, strengthen compliance, and provide healthcare organizations with greater visibility into the clinical, operational, and financial performance of procedural care.

Our technology works directly within operating rooms and procedural environments, helping nurses and clinicians spend less time on administrative tasks and more time focused on patients.

About the Role

MedGEO is seeking a highly motivated **Clinical Implementation \& Customer Success Manager** to lead customer onboarding, clinical implementation, training, go\-live support, adoption, and ongoing customer success for our healthcare technology platform.

This role requires a **nursing background**, with **operating room, perioperative, surgical services, or procedural\-care experience strongly preferred**. The ideal candidate understands the realities of surgical workflows, clinical documentation, supplies, implants, preference cards, physician and nursing workflows, and the operational demands placed on OR teams.

You will serve as a primary point of contact for customers, helping clinical teams successfully adopt MedGEO’s technology and ensuring customers achieve meaningful clinical, operational, and financial value. This is a hands\-on, customer\-facing role that requires strong communication, project management, technical aptitude, and the ability to work closely with hospital teams as well as MedGEO’s Product, Engineering, Sales, and leadership teams.

This role requires onsite travel for implementations and go\-lives, with expected travel ranging from approximately **20% to 50% of the time**, depending on customer growth, implementation schedules, go\-live activity, and business needs.

Because MedGEO is still in an early and formative stage of growth, this role also includes the opportunity to participate in the company’s long\-term upside through **early equity in the company**. We are looking for someone who wants to help build the customer success and implementation function, contribute meaningfully to the company’s growth, and share in the value they help create as MedGEO scales.

The right person will be comfortable working in a fast\-moving startup environment, rolling up their sleeves during implementations and go\-lives, and helping build the customer success function as MedGEO grows.

* Lead end\-to\-end clinical implementation processes, including planning, workflow assessment, training, go\-live readiness, launch support, and post\-launch stabilization.
* Work directly with OR nurses, surgeons, perioperative leaders, hospital administrators, IT, supply chain, revenue cycle, and other customer stakeholders.
* Assess current clinical workflows and determine how MedGEO should be incorporated into existing surgical and procedural processes.
* Support implementation of MedGEO workflows related to surgical documentation, supplies, implants, preference cards, intraoperative resource utilization, Smart Vision, and related platform capabilities.
* Develop implementation plans, timelines, milestones, training schedules, and go\-live readiness criteria.
* Provide onsite and remote support during customer onboarding, training, go\-live, and optimization periods.
* Proactively identify implementation risks, workflow issues, adoption barriers, and customer concerns, and escalate as needed.

Customer Success \& Adoption

* Serve as a trusted clinical and operational partner for assigned customers.
* Build strong relationships with frontline clinicians, nurse managers, perioperative directors, surgeons, IT teams, supply chain, revenue cycle, and executive stakeholders.
* Monitor customer adoption, utilization, engagement, satisfaction, and workflow performance.
* Identify adoption gaps and work directly with customer teams to improve usage, training, and workflow alignment.
* Provide ongoing education and support to existing and new users.
* Communicate new MedGEO functionality, best practices, and workflow recommendations to customers.
* Help develop customer champions who can support adoption internally and serve as references for MedGEO externally.

Product Commercialization \& Voice of the Customer

* Serve as a bridge between customers and MedGEO’s Product, Engineering, Sales, and leadership teams.
* Translate frontline clinical feedback into clear product recommendations, workflow improvements, training needs, and commercialization priorities.
* Help Product and Engineering understand how MedGEO performs in real\-world OR and procedural environments.
* Identify recurring customer pain points, workflow challenges, usability issues, and opportunities for product improvement.
* Support rollout of new product capabilities, modules, Smart Vision enhancements, analytics features, and workflow tools.
* Contribute to customer\-facing materials, training resources, workflow guides, implementation playbooks, and product adoption best practices.
* Help determine whether new product features are ready for broader customer rollout based on usability, workflow fit, customer readiness, and measurable value.

Customer Value, Expansion \& Retention

* Help customers understand and measure the clinical, operational, and financial value generated by MedGEO.
* Track improvements in documentation efficiency, utilization capture, accuracy, compliance, workflow performance, and financial outcomes.
* Support customer business reviews, ROI discussions, executive updates, and account health reporting.

**Job Title:** Content Marketing Manager

**Company:** Tacos 1986

**Location:** Los Angeles, CA (In\-field \& On\-site)

**Compensation:** $75,000 Starting Base Salary

**Who We Are**

Tacos 1986 brings the unfiltered, high\-energy experience of a Tijuana street taqueria straight to Los Angeles. We’re known for our trompo, fresh\-pressed masa, and cult\-favorite menu that communities love. We don’t do boring corporate food. We create real, raw, fast\-paced culinary experiences across our brick\-and\-mortar locations, major music festivals, pop\-ups, catering events, and private activations.

**The Role**

We’re looking for a dynamic storyteller, content strategist, and brand\-minded creator to become the in\-house documentarian of Tacos 1986\. The scope of the role will continue to evolve alongside the company.

This is much more than scheduling social posts. You’ll be capturing taqueros slicing adobada off the trompo, documenting festival load\-ins, building our YouTube presence, highlighting parts of the brand our audience may not know about, and helping turn our social reach into real\-world awareness, catering leads, and event opportunities.

You’ll work closely with our marketing team to ensure all content supports the larger marketing calendar, campaigns, promotions, partnerships, and overall brand direction. While there will always be opportunities to capture spontaneous moments, this role requires **proactive planning, scheduling, and pre\-production of shoots** so we consistently have the right content for upcoming initiatives.

**What You Will Do**

* **Produce Weekly Social Content:** Shoot, edit, deliver and post approximately **4–5 high\-energy short\-form videos per week** for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and other social platforms. Shoot accompanying photography when needed for marketing initiatives.
* **Plan \& Schedule Content Shoots:** Work ahead of the marketing calendar to identify content needs, coordinate locations and talent, build shot lists, and schedule dedicated shoot days for upcoming campaigns, menu launches, partnerships, and events.
* **Partner With the Marketing Team:** Work closely with marketing to ensure content remains aligned with Tacos 1986’s brand identity, campaign priorities, promotions, partnerships, and business objectives.
* **Build the YouTube Channel:** Develop longer\-form vlogs, mini\-documentaries, behind\-the\-scenes features, and recurring concepts showcasing ingredient sourcing, festival load\-ins, restaurant culture, events, and the people behind Tacos 1986\.
* **Own the Narrative:** Capture the grit, personality, and energy behind the brand—from early\-morning prep and busy restaurant services to weekend pop\-ups and large\-scale festival activations across Southern California.
* **Expand Brand Awareness:** Create dedicated content around offerings our audience may not fully know about, including happy hour, breakfast, catering, new menu initiatives, special events, and other emerging programs.

jobs.title: Talent Administrative Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

The Talent Administrative Coordinator provides day\-to\-day administrative support to the Talent Manager and helps ensure that new hires and employees move smoothly through Active Learning’s onboarding and employee processes.This is a highly organized, communication\-focused administrative position. The primary responsibilities include coordinating new hire onboarding, communicating with candidates and employees, collecting and tracking required documentation, maintaining employee records and compliance trackers, assisting with employee updates, and supporting offboarding processes.The Talent Administrative Coordinator will frequently communicate with new hires, prospective employees, and current staff and must be professional, responsive, welcoming, and comfortable following up consistently regarding deadlines and outstanding requirements.This position reports directly to the Talent Manager and supports the Talent Manager in maintaining organized, accurate, and efficient Talent operations.

**Key ResponsibilitiesNew Hire Onboarding \& Communication**

* Coordinate administrative onboarding steps for new hires from the time an offer is accepted through completion of onboarding.
* Serve as a primary administrative point of contact for new hires throughout the onboarding process.
* Communicate clearly and professionally with new hires regarding required documentation, deadlines, training, orientation, and next steps.
* Send onboarding paperwork, forms, instructions, and reminders.
* Collect, review, organize, and track required new hire documentation.
* Follow up consistently with new hires regarding incomplete or outstanding requirements.
* Coordinate pre\-employment requirements such as Live Scan/background clearance, TB clearance, CPR/First Aid certifications, Mandated Reporter requirements, and other applicable documentation.
* Prepare onboarding materials and assist with new hire orientations and onboarding sessions.
* Maintain organized onboarding checklists and trackers to ensure each new hire completes requirements on time.
* Communicate onboarding status and outstanding items to the Talent Manager.

**Candidate \& Employee Communication**

* Professionally communicate with prospective employees, new hires, and current employees regarding Talent\-related administrative processes.
* Respond to routine questions regarding onboarding, documentation, required certifications, training requirements, and next steps.
* Send reminders and follow\-up communications when information or documentation is outstanding.
* Maintain a welcoming and professional tone while also clearly communicating expectations and deadlines.
* Escalate employee relations, HR, compensation, or other sensitive matters to the Talent Manager or appropriate HR representative.

**Employee Documentation \& Records**

* Maintain accurate and organized employee personnel records.
* File and update employee documents throughout the employee lifecycle.
* Review employee records regularly for missing, incomplete, or expired documentation.
* Follow up with employees regarding required updates or missing information.
* Maintain confidentiality when handling employee and candidate information.
* Ensure internal employee trackers and records remain accurate and current.

**Compliance \& Certification Tracking**

* Maintain administrative trackers for employee certifications, clearances, and required employment documentation.
* Monitor expiration dates and upcoming renewal requirements.
* Send employees reminders regarding expiring or outstanding documentation.
* Follow up until required documentation has been received.
* Provide regular updates to the Talent Manager regarding outstanding requirements.
* Escalate urgent or unresolved compliance matters when appropriate.

**Employee Changes \& Offboarding Support**

* Assist with administrative processing of approved employee changes.
* Update internal trackers and employee records following approved changes.
* Maintain documentation related to employee updates.
* Assist the Talent Manager with employee offboarding procedures.
* Prepare and organize applicable separation documentation and internal notifications.
* Update employee records and trackers following separation.
* Ensure employee files are complete and properly organized.

**Talent Administrative Support**

* Maintain Talent calendars, employee trackers, onboarding lists, spreadsheets, and administrative records.
* Prepare employee communications, forms, letters, and Talent\-related documents.
* Assist with scheduling orientations, onboarding appointments, trainings, and other Talent activities.
* Assist the Talent Manager with employee\-related projects and administrative assignments.
* Help maintain organized Talent systems, folders, files, and processes.
* Identify missing information, upcoming deadlines, or incomplete tasks and proactively follow up.
* Provide additional administrative support to the Talent Manager as needed.

**Qualifications**

* Previous administrative, onboarding, recruiting coordination, employee services, or office support experience preferred.
* Strong administrative and organizational skills.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable communicating professionally with candidates, new hires, employees, and managers.
* Ability to manage multiple deadlines, employees, documents, and follow\-ups simultaneously.
* Strong follow\-through and ability to stay on top of outstanding items without constant supervision.
* Ability to maintain confidential employee information.
* Comfortable working with spreadsheets, trackers, email, calendars, and electronic files.
* Proficiency with Google Workspace and/or Microsoft Office.
* Experience with onboarding or employee management systems preferred.
* ADP experience is a plus.
* Ability to work independently while understanding when an issue should be escalated to the Talent Manager.

jobs.description:

**Position Summary:**


The Events \& National Account Manager owns the end\-to\-end performance of our Field Marketing Event team as well as our retail partnerships with Lowe’s, Sam’s Club, BJ’s, and Costco, serving as the primary point of accountability for revenue, lead generation, and store\-level execution across an assigned territory. This role combines field leadership, data\-driven program management, and executive\-level relationship building to maximize the productivity of every store within the program.


The successful candidate will spend significant time in stores coaching associates, equipping lead takers with the tools and training they need to succeed, and engaging both store leadership and district and regional management across our retail partners. * **Measure training effectiveness** by tracking lead volume, quality, and conversion before and after each session, and adjust curriculum based on results.
* **Manage day\-to\-day performance** of all stores in the assigned territory, with clear weekly and monthly lead generation targets per store.
* **Lead Field Lead Generation activities** in store, including event execution, in\-aisle engagement programs, promotional displays, and associate\-driven referrals.

* **Identify underperforming stores** and design targeted intervention plans that include training, staffing, merchandising, and event support.
* **Advocate for the program** during Home Depot store visits, district meetings, and regional reviews, establishing our brand as a leading service provider. **Develop and sustain trusted relationships** within Home Depot Stores.
* **Create and own a strategic plan** for the Home Depot program that defines revenue targets, growth initiatives, investment priorities, and resource needs.
* **Drive revenue growth** from Field Lead Generation activities by prioritizing the highest\-ROI stores, events, and product categories.
* **Partner cross\-functionally** with Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Installation teams to ensure leads convert efficiently and customer experience remains best in class.
* **Forecast and budget** field activity spend, event costs, and staffing against expected lead and revenue returns.
* **Review lead taker data** weekly to identify trends in productivity, lead quality, store mix, and event ROI.
* **Prepare and present business reviews** (weekly, monthly, and quarterly) with clear key findings, root\-cause analysis, and prioritized action items for both internal leadership and Home Depot counterparts.
* **Translate data into action** by turning insights into specific coaching plans, training topics, event adjustments, and staffing decisions.

* 3–5 years of experience in field sales, retail program management, lead generation, or big\-box partnership management.
* Demonstrated track record of driving revenue growth in a retail or in\-store environment.

Our integrated, privacy\-safe platform, enables life sciences companies to drive measurable patient and commercial outcomes with actionable intelligence — spanning patient and HCP audience targeting, community engagement, AI\-powered web solutions, coordinated omnichannel activation, and prescription fulfillment.
  
  

We believe our people are our greatest asset. Swoop fosters a culture of innovation and continuous learning, providing employees with rich opportunities for professional growth. This commitment to our team earned us the "Best Places to Work" recognition from Business Intelligence Group in 2025 and 2026\. We are driven by a patient\-first philosophy and passionate about leveraging technology to create a healthier future.
  
  

After becoming an independent company in 2024, Swoop experienced significant growth and demonstrated an unwavering commitment to innovation, talent development, and enhancing the patient experience. Our acquisition of MyHealthTeam in January 2025 and Nimble in May 2026 helped us further bridging the gap between healthcare brands and patients for more impactful and targeted engagement. Empowering millions of patients nationwide to connect, share resources, and access medically verified information to better manage their health. MyHealthTeam hosts the largest and most engaged patient social networks in healthcare, offering more than 70 condition\-specific communities for chronic and rare conditions. As a prescription fulfillment and patient engagement platform, Nimble empowers independent and regional pharmacies to deliver a modern, consumer\-friendly healthcare experience while streamlining pharmacy operations.
  
  

If you're a driven professional seeking to make a real difference in healthcare marketing at a fast\-growing, innovative company, join Swoop and help us revolutionize how brands connect with patients and HCPs.
  
  

About the role
  
  

NimbleRx is looking for a motivated and ambitious Sales Development Representative from the tech/healthcare space to join our growing Sales Team. As an SDR, you will be the first point of contact for potential pharmacy partners and play a crucial role in driving our sales pipeline.
  
  

In this role, you will be responsible for scheduling appointments for our Account Executives to demo our product for local and regional pharmacy groups. The ideal candidate is a self\-starter with an ability to adapt quickly and a team player with a passion for making an impact and building a career in a SaaS sales role!
  
  

What you'll do
  
  

Drive strategic outreach (cold calling, email campaigns, etc.) to large pharmacy groups to determine decision\-makers within target pharmacies.
  
Employ effective selling techniques including research, building rapport, productive questions, and issue identification.
  
Build relationships with pharmacy owners/decision\-makers to establish trust and confidence in NimbleRx's exciting tech\-driven product.
  
Schedule product demos for Account Executives and ensure prospects are prepared and engaged for the next steps in the sales process.
  
Work closely with the Sales and Marketing teams to align messaging, strategies, and goals for optimal outreach.
  
Maintain accurate records of prospect interactions, track progress, and update lead statuses in our CRM (Customer Relationship Management) system, Salesforce.
  
Develop strategic account and opportunity insights by analyzing previously closed opportunities, historical conversation notes, and customer feedback to identify patterns, barriers, and high\-potential paths to engagement.
  
Lead thoughtful, research\-driven prospecting by incorporating pharmacy\-specific insights, including public reviews and customer sentiment, into personalized outreach and precall strategies.
  
  

Qualifications
  
  

1 or more years of tech sales experience
  
Experience in the tech/healthcare space
  
A passion for working directly with customers and making an impact
  
A positive attitude and an ability to work in a fast\-paced, constantly evolving environment
  
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  
A bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
  
  

This role offers a base salary plus uncapped commission.

jobs.description:
Western Allied Mechanical stands on the cutting edge of HVAC system design and operation. We combine innovative thinking and technologies with our intricate engineering to create, build and maintain comfortable, energy\-efficient environments. Our relational focus and entrepreneurial spirit continually drive us to attract and develop the finest talent, while building and enduring customer relationships. We strive to be Driven by Innovation, Grounded in Care and Dedicated to Teamwork. Western Allied has been Operating for over 60 years as a mechanical contractor for bio\-tech, high tech, retrofit, and LEED/Green projects. We are looking for intelligent, organized and innovative people to join our team!

**Description of Position**

The project coordinator supports the project executive(s) and his/her team’s project management staff. The project management staff includes senior project managers, project managers, and project engineers. The purpose of this role is to provide project\-specific administrative support to the team(s), ensure smooth administrative project execution, coordinate and communicate between administrative stakeholders inside and outside of the company, and use project management software to keep the project organized and on track. The project coordinator may also provide some executive assistance to the project executive as needed.

**Pay Range:** $70,000\.00 \- $105,000\.00 (range is dependent on years of experience)

**Duties \& Responsibilities**

* Coordinate project setup, maintenance, and closeout activities, including job creation, contract processing, change orders, certified payroll setup, bond administration, and project documentation management in Spectrum, Procore/ACC, and related systems.
* Manage bid administration, including bid setup, document maintenance, proposal package preparation, and tracking through company systems.
* Prepare and administer subcontracts, and subcontract change orders, including DocuSign execution and record maintenance.
* Serve as a liaison between Project Managers and internal departments such as Accounting, Payroll, and Compliance to resolve issues and support project execution.
* Support project teams by contributing to various administrative, coordination, and documentation\-related activities throughout the project lifecycle.
* Generate project reporting and maintain financial and operational records, including monthly P\&L reports.
* Support company programs and industry outreach initiatives as needed.

**Requirements \& Qualifications**

* Minimum of 2–3 years of experience in an administrative or office support role preferred
* Experience in project coordination, construction administration, project management support, or a related field preferred.
* Experience working with contracts and contract\-related documentation, construction project processes and requirements
* Proficiency with Spectrum, ACC, Bluebeam, Asana, DocuSign, Microsoft Office Suite, and other construction management software.
* Strong organizational, time management, and multitasking skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across departments and with external partners.
* Detail\-oriented with strong problem\-solving abilities and a commitment to accuracy.
* Experience in mechanical contracting, HVAC, plumbing, or construction industries preferred.
* Ability to work independently while supporting a fast\-paced project environment.

**Physical Demands of Position**

* Long periods of sitting and/or standing and/or walking
* Must be able to travel to and visit jobsites as needed in support of assigned responsibilities.
* Walking on uneven surfaces
* Must be able to access roofs and elevated areas, sometimes requiring climbing of ladders and stairs
* Keyboarding
* Crouching, kneeling, or stooping at jobsite visits

Working at Western Allied Mechanical comes with a competitive salary and complete benefits package that includes a 401K Plan and Paid Time Off. This is a rewarding position that offers the excitement and satisfaction of working both individually and with a team. As a company with fewer than 350 employees, we are focused on supporting the professional growth of our employees and treating them like family. Our open\-door policy facilitates our culture of mutual support that permeates the work experience. Our east\-bay location is ideal for commutes from all over the bay area.

Western Allied Mechanical is an equal opportunity employer located in Union City, CA. To be considered for this position, please submit your resume and cover letter describing your experience and interest in working with us.

Graduate Program Coordinator, Biosciences (5156C) \#88591 About Berkeley
  
  

At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation \- driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  

At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full\-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  

We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  

Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  

Departmental Overview
  
  

The Departments of Molecular and Cell Biology (MCB), Integrative Biology (IB), and Neuroscience (NEU) are among the largest academic departments at UC Berkeley. By several measures (including number of faculty and students, budget, and assigned square feet), these departments are larger than many UCB colleges and schools.
  
  

The three departments represent over 186 faculty FTE (including Adjuncts, Professors of the Graduate School, active emeriti, and 21 HHMI professors); 140 Researchers and Specialists; 185 post\-doctoral researchers; 350 graduate students; 2,100 undergraduate students; 60 department staff members; and a total state and extramural payroll of approximately 1,450 (including Graduate Student Instructors, Graduate Student Researchers, and research staff).
  
  

Financial resources include approximately $90M in annual extramural funding (which accounts for over half of the total sponsored research awards in the College of Letters \& Science) and over $91M other fund sources. Department personnel are currently housed in eight buildings located in three widely separated parts of the campus.
  
  

Position Summary
  
  

The Graduate Program Coordinator provides a wide range of student services to the Graduate Affairs Office in support of the Integrative Biology and Molecular \& Cell Biology Ph.D. programs. This position leads projects while collaborating with and supporting team members, faculty, and students. The Graduate Program Coordinator manages large\-scale events and projects, including recruitment, commencement, and Graduate Student Instructor (GSI) hiring, as well as smaller\-scale events such as orientation and regular student programming. Additionally, this position provides administrative and operational support in areas such as communications, student advising, data collection and analysis, and student reimbursement processing.
  
  

Application Review Date
  
  

The First Review Date for this job is September 14, 2026\. For full consideration, please apply by the first review date.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
  

Event Planning (Recruitment, Orientation, Commencement) \- 45%
  
  

Recruitment \& Admissions
  
  

Plans, implements, and manages in\-person recruitment visits of prospective graduate students to MCB. Leads planning meetings with MCB GAO staff, Admissions Chairs, and student Recruitment Representatives.
  
Organizes two in\-person recruitment weekends for approximately 100\-130 individuals (applicants generally participate in 2 groups of 50\-65 individuals in January/February).
  
Acts as lead coordinator for the department, working closely with Biological Sciences Program Directors at other west coast universities regarding setting of dates, coordinating travel, and arrangements for travel between campuses as necessary.
  
Acts as lead department representative to applicants visiting the campus in all matters relating to travel, lodging, and faculty appointments. Coordinates with university travel agents on all travel arrangements for visiting applicants.
  
In collaboration with the student Recruitment Representatives, coordinates current graduate student participation in the recruitment process, including but not limited to housing visitors, contacting recruits, and organizing visit day activities such as panel discussions, poster sessions, seminars, and social activities.
  
Responsible for establishing contracts with local hotels for accommodation blocks. Plans and manages all group events, including seminars, panel discussions, catered meals, and faculty dinners. Negotiates any necessary service provider contracts. Provides on\-site management for all recruitment events. Maintains computer databases of all pertinent correspondence, schedules, and costs.
  
Compiles and rewrites, as necessary, all departmental information for visitors' packets.
  
Supports the department's extensive efforts to recruit students from historically underrepresented populations to the graduate program.
  
  

Commencement
  
  

Assists in other areas of the admissions process as needed, including the handling of \~800 applications received annually.
  
Plans and coordinates MCBs Graduate Commencement. Conducts meetings throughout the spring semester to organize and plan the commencement ceremony held each May at a campus venue (currently the Zellerbach Playhouse). Delegates commencement tasks to other graduate student services staff and student staff as needed.
  
Reserves commencement ceremony and reception venues and enters into catering and service contracts necessary for a successful event.

jobs.title: Program Coordinator - Women's Center
jobs.description:
**About Glide**
GLIDE is a nationally recognized center for social justice, dedicated to fighting systemic injustices, creating pathways out of poverty and crisis, and transforming lives. Through its integrated comprehensive services, advocacy initiatives, and inclusive community, GLIDE empowers individuals, families, and children to achieve stability and to thrive. GLIDE is on the forefront of addressing some of society’s most pressing issues, including poverty, housing and homelessness, and racial and social justice. GLIDE’s mission is to create a radically inclusive, just, and loving community mobilized to alleviate suffering and break the cycles of poverty and marginalization **Position Summary**:
GLIDE’s Women’s Center is seeking a compassionate and organized Program Coordinator to support the delivery of services for individuals who identify as women who are in immediate need of housing, essential needs (e.g., food, clothes, hygiene supplies) health and mental health services, navigation, and case management support, group support, etc. due to homelessness, gender\-based violence, and trauma. The Women’s Center will assess client’s needs, provide information and support to overcome barriers, provide early intervention, and case management. The Women’s Center Program Coordinator will assist the Senior Director to plan, coordinate, and implement the Center’s programs and services, provide direct services, and support other general operations of the program, such as facilitate/co\-facilitate groups and plan Center events. This individual will collaborate with the director, staff, and community partners to ensure compliance with multiple\-funding sources and their requirements.
### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities**


* Develop, coordinate, and maintain relationships and collaborations with GLIDE’s programs, established and new community partners to benefit participants and promote GLIDE’s Women’s Center.
* Be responsible for the coordination, creation, maintenance of service and/or staff schedules and business documentation (e.g. reports, flyers).
* Working in collaboration with case managers, develop and document Individualized Service Plans (ISPs) for clients, including data entry and reporting through CRM tools. Be responsible for organizing and managing Women’s Center events, which will involve coordinating all logistical aspects.
* Provide data coordination and quality assurance checks to ensure services meet predetermined standards and client satisfaction.
* Provide low\-threshold advocacy and case management, which includes referral, linkages, and assistance to health, health services, legal aid, and other human services and resources to support the client to reach their goals for improved safety, wellness, and quality of life.
* Conduct street and community outreach and attend community events to reach women and to promote the Women’s Center.
* Collaborate with Director to assign administrative tasks, referrals, cases, etc. to program staff. Ensure timely referral processing and allocation of new cases to other Women’s Center staff.
* Perform triage, intakes, needs assessments, service planning, service coordination, and follow up contacts in person, by email or phone with clients and other providers.
* Apply strength\-based services that are centered around motivational interviewing, cultural humility, and trauma\-informed care.
* Plan, organize, and oversee group sessions, activities, workshops, and individual support servies for clients Lead/co\-facilitate women educational and empowerment groups virtually and onsite.
* Maintain files and database records to track client progress. Prepare reports, success stories and challenges for internal review and reporting to external funders and stakeholders,; Ensure timely and accurate compliance with all reporting requirements.
* Adhere to professional boundaries and standards. Understand and follow basis ethics, values, and principles of regulatory practices. Adhere to all laws and requirements regarding HIPPA, confidentiality, child protective services, contractual agreements, etc.
* Meet professional obligations through efficient work habits such as collaborating with co\-workers, meeting deadlines, honoring schedules, attend and actively participating in staff and individual meeting, community meeting, supervision, case conferences, client conferences and in\-service trainings.
### **Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in relevant field (e.g., psychology, social work, sociology, criminal justice) preferred; or at least four years of experience providing services (e.g., case management, or coordination of services) to women experiencing homelessness, domestic violence, gender\-based violence, and/or have been incarcerated.
* Demonstrated understanding of the psycho\-social and economic issues that impact women.
* Group facilitation experience helpful.
* Facilitates collaboration among Women’s Center staff and other GLIDE departments.
* Ability to develop processes and operations to support the implantation of new ideas and approaches.
* Knowledge of trauma informed approaches in supporting vulnerable women with a range of complex needs, particularly women of color experience houselessness, poverty, and other traumatic experiences.
* Has the ability to work effectively across cultures.
* Ability to plan, prioritize and organize tasks and meet deadlines, Strong attention to detail, particularly documentation of case files and updating database.
* Works well under pressure and manages stress effectively in a demanding and fast paced environment.
* Commitment to the mission, values, and philosophy of GLIDE.
### **Physical Requirements**


Reasonable accommodations can be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
* Ability to work on a computer and see details of objects at close range.
* Ability to hear within normal range, and communicate effectively (in person, telephone or Zoom).
*

This individual will help the department increase the number of volunteers at GLIDE, increase volunteer retention and repeat volunteerism, and support Community Service volunteers to acquire new skills and access pathways to employment. * 2\+ years of experience working in a non\-profit, education, or social impact organization required.

jobs.description:
**Executive Assistant to the CEO / Executive Operations Coordinator**
=====================================================================

**Position Summary**
--------------------


The Executive Assistant to the CEO / Executive Operations Coordinator provides high\-level administrative, organizational, and operational support to the CEO and Executive Team. This position helps keep executive priorities, meetings, projects, communications, and follow\-up activities organized and moving forward.


The role works closely with the CEO, Chief Clinical Officer (CCO), Vice President, Head of People, and Executive Clinical Team. The Executive Assistant serves as a central point of coordination across these leaders and helps ensure that information, decisions, assignments, and deadlines are communicated and followed through appropriately.


This is not a traditional administrative support position. The successful candidate must be comfortable working directly with senior leadership, managing competing priorities, coordinating cross\-functional work, identifying issues before they become problems, and operating independently with limited day\-to\-day direction.


The position requires a high level of discretion because it involves access to confidential executive, employee, financial, clinical, legal, operational, and organizational information.

**Primary Responsibilities**
----------------------------

* Manage the CEO's calendar, including scheduling, prioritizing meetings, resolving conflicts, and adjusting schedules as organizational priorities change.
* Keep the CEO informed of upcoming commitments, deadlines, meetings, decisions, and follow\-up items.
* Prepare the CEO for meetings by gathering information, preparing briefing materials, coordinating presentations, and identifying outstanding items that require attention.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for matters involving the CEO and determine whether requests should be handled directly, referred to another leader, or elevated to the CEO.
* Prepare correspondence, reports, presentations, agendas, spreadsheets, talking points, and other executive\-level materials.
* Coordinate business travel, itineraries, lodging, transportation, and related documentation.
* Prepare or coordinate expense and mileage reports.
* Maintain executive contact lists, records, files, and other information.

### **Executive Operations and Cross\-Functional Coordination**

* Work closely with the CEO, CCO, VP, Head of People, Executive Clinical Team, and Leadership Team(s) to coordinate organizational priorities and executive\-level initiatives.
* Support the CEO in tracking major organizational priorities, projects, deadlines, and commitments.
* Maintain project timelines, action\-item lists, and follow\-up trackers for initiatives assigned by executive leadership.
* Coordinate information and deliverables across Clinical, Operations, Finance, People/HR, Compliance, Training, and other departments as needed.
* Follow up with leaders and staff regarding assignments and deadlines established by the CEO or Executive Team.
* Identify delays, gaps, conflicting priorities, or other issues that could affect completion of an assignment and bring them to the appropriate leader's attention.
* Help move projects from planning through completion by coordinating people, information, deadlines, meetings, and deliverables.
* Prepare status updates, summaries, and reports for the CEO and Executive Team.
* Help ensure decisions made by executive leadership are communicated to the appropriate individuals and followed through.

### **Organizational Planning**

* Assist the CEO and Executive Team with quarterly and annual organizational planning.
* Coordinate the collection of information, reports, metrics, and updates needed for leadership planning.
* Maintain planning calendars and track key organizational deadlines.
* Assist with preparation for leadership planning meetings and organizational initiatives.
* Help coordinate follow\-through on priorities established during executive planning sessions.
* Organize information from multiple departments into clear summaries and materials for executive review.
* Assist with implementation and coordination of organizational initiatives as assigned by executive leadership.

### **CEO Communication and Relationship Management**

* Serve as a professional liaison between the CEO and employees, executives, leaders, vendors, community partners, and other external stakeholders.
* Respond to and appropriately route communications directed to the CEO.
* Use sound judgment when determining the urgency and appropriate handling of requests.
* Maintain professional working relationships with individuals at all levels of the organization.
* Represent the CEO's office professionally and consistently with organizational expectations.

**POSITION SUMMARY**  

The Buck Institute is seeking an **Executive Assistant** to support the Chief Scientific Officer (CSO) and Executive Office. This role provides comprehensive administrative support for the CSO’s executive and laboratory activities, while also supporting the broader executive branch.  

  

This is an on\-site position with the possibility of working hybrid one day per week when on\-site activities are not required.  

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**  

***Support to CSO (approx. 80%/4 days per week on\-site)**** Manage the CSO’s calendar, appointments, meetings, events, and priorities; coordinate travel itineraries and reimbursements for the CSO and lab members.
* Provide comprehensive administrative support to the CSO, including drafting and managing correspondence, maintaining CSO and laboratory files and documents, responding to staff and external inquiries, ordering supplies, photocopying, and running errands.
* Support all activities of the Committee of Affiliations and Promotions, including drafting and sending letters of recommendation on behalf of the CSO and coordinating public and faculty seminars.
* Serve as administrative coordinator for the Office for Education and Training, supporting educational and training events, communications and advertising, appreciation weeks, on\-site retreats, and development of a new PhD graduate program.
* Coordinate the R13 NIA Summer Training Course, including annual applications and execution of the course when hosted at Buck every three years.
* Coordinate laboratory operations and recruiting activities, including schedules and meetings, room reservations, catering, setup/takedown, and applications and interviews for laboratory positions.
* Plan and coordinate recurring scientific, faculty, leadership, and educational meetings and events, including agendas, schedules, invitations, materials, minutes, catering, travel reimbursements, IT/AV support, and on\-site logistics. Programs include:
	+ Monthly faculty, leadership, and education meetings
	+ Bi\-weekly Internal Research Seminars, including bi\-annual scheduling
	+ Podium Pointers training sessions for mentors and trainees supporting the Internal Research Seminars, Bay Area Aging Meeting, Glenn\-Campisi Symposium, Buck Student Annual Symposium, and VITAL Symposium
	+ Scientific Advisory Board meetings held every 18 months, including lunch and dinner logistics

***Executive Team/BOT Support (approx. 20%/1 day per week on\-site)**** Provide administrative and executive support to the Executive Team as needed, including data processing, correspondence, and scheduling meetings.
* Process check requests, reimbursements, package mailing, and purchase orders; order and maintain office supplies for the Executive Team.
* Support and coordinate Executive Office in\-person meetings and on\-site events on scheduled onsite days.

***General**** Resolve scheduling conflicts by assessing competing needs and priorities
* Respond to urgent issues outside normal business hours.
* Backup Admin Lab Coordinators as needed.
* Demonstrate strong customer service skills in interactions with internal and external stakeholders.

**QUALIFICATIONS**  

**Education \& Experience*** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree
* 5\+ years’ successful administrative experience in a non\-profit, research, or academic environment supporting multiple high\-level professionals.
* Supervisory experience preferred.
* Experience with NIH grant applications, PubMed, and eRA Commons preferred

**Specialized Skills*** Ability to work independently, take initiative, and demonstrate good judgment.
* Ability to professionally and courteously communicate with diverse individuals and personalities at all levels, including faculty, leadership staff, laboratory personnel, and the public.
* Excellent written, verbal, organizational, and administrative skills, with strict confidentiality always.
* Excellent organizational and multitasking skills with the ability to manage simultaneous projects of varying complexity and meet deadlines.
* Proven accuracy and attention to detail.
* Demonstrated supervisory and critical\-thinking skills.
* Highly proficient with Macintosh, MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, database and graphics programs.
* Strong proficiency with office management technologies and video conferencing software.
* Experience planning and scheduling meetings and seminars, including national and international travel and coordination of AV needs with IT
* A lifelong learner committed to the Buck’s mission.

**COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS*** Annual salary of $95,000 \- $115,000, commensurate with experience and skill set.
* Generous benefits including health insurance, paid parental leave, vacation/sick leave, a 401(k) with 5% employer match, and student loan repayment.
* Collaborative environment supporting both science and social activities.

**WHY WORK AT THE BUCK INSTITUTE?**  

Our success will ultimately change healthcare. The Buck Institute aims to end the threat of age\-related diseases for current and future generations by bringing together highly capable and passionate scientists from a broad range of disciplines to identify and impede the mechanisms of aging.  

  

Located in Marin County, California, the Buck is an independent nonprofit institution dedicated to increasing human healthspan—the healthy years of life. Globally recognized as a pioneer and leader in targeting aging, the number one risk factor for diseases including Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, cancer, macular degeneration, heart disease, and diabetes, the Buck seeks to help people live better, longer.  

  

The Buck Institute is an equal\-opportunity employer.  

  

**TO APPLY**  

Interested candidates should apply online and upload a CV and cover letter that includes contact information for three professional references.

jobs.title: Events & Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**About Build AI**
------------------


Build AI is the data hyperscaler for Physical AI. We're vertically integrated across hardware, manufacturing, logistics, collection, and model training to scale the physical labor dataset orders of magnitude faster than anyone in the world.

**About the Role**
------------------


We're looking for our first Events \& Field Marketing Manager to build Build's events function from scratch.


You'll own how Build shows up in the world: the conferences we sponsor, the events we host around them, and the standalone experiences we create for customers, prospects, candidates, and the broader physical AI community.


This is a strategy **and** execution role. You'll decide where Build should invest, develop creative ways to stand out, and personally make the details happen. One week that might mean planning Build's presence at NeurIPS or CoRL; the next it could mean putting together an intimate dinner for AI researchers, a recruiting event in San Francisco, or an event format we haven't tried before.


You'll have significant autonomy, budget, and responsibility for representing Build externally.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Build and own Build's events calendar and strategy from scratch.
* Own Build's presence at major AI and robotics conferences, including sponsorships, attendance, activations, and related events.
* Create and execute standalone events for customers, prospects, candidates, and the AI and robotics community \- including events ranging from executive dinners and small gatherings to recruiting events, conferences, launches, and larger experiences.
* Identify which conferences and events Build should invest in based on customer, recruiting, and brand impact.
* Develop creative concepts that make Build memorable and differentiated rather than simply showing up with a booth.
* Own events end\-to\-end: concept, venue, vendors, contracts, budgets, guest lists, invitations, logistics, onsite execution, and follow\-up.
* Measure what works and turn successful experiments into repeatable programs.
* Build the systems and operating processes required to scale the function as Build grows.

**You May Be a Good Fit If You**
--------------------------------

* Have **2\+ years of experience** in events, field marketing, experiential marketing, or a related role.
* Have personally owned conferences, sponsored events, dinners, or other in\-person experiences from concept through execution.
* Are exceptionally organized and detail oriented. You can run several complex projects simultaneously without dropping things.
* Have high agency. When something needs to happen, your instinct is to figure out how to make it happen rather than wait for instructions.
* Are creative and have strong taste. You care about creating experiences people actually remember.
* Are scrappy. You're equally comfortable negotiating a major sponsorship and fixing a last\-minute problem yourself five minutes before an event starts.
* Exercise excellent judgment and can represent Build confidently with customers, researchers, candidates, executives, and partners.
* Thrive in ambiguity and like building things from zero rather than inheriting established processes.
* Are willing to travel regularly for conferences and events.

**Even Better If**
------------------

* You've worked at a fast\-growing startup and know what it means to operate without much infrastructure.
* You have experience in AI, technology, robotics, or another technical industry.
* You've built an events or field marketing program rather than only executing an existing playbook.
* You've found unconventional ways to create memorable events without simply spending more money.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------


Build becomes one of the companies people consistently notice at the most important AI and robotics gatherings.


Our customers and prospects want to attend our events. Great candidates encounter Build through experiences that make them want to join. Our conference investments produce real relationships and opportunities. And behind the scenes, the entire program runs with exceptional operational discipline.


You turn events into a competitive advantage for Build to scale recruiting, brand, and customer acquisition.

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive pay
* Medical, dental, and vision packages with generous premium coverage
* $500 per month credit for waiving medical benefits
* Housing subsidy of $2k per month for those living within walking distance of the office
* Relocation support for those moving to San Francisco (Financial District) or Shenzhen (Nanshan)
* Various wellness benefits covering fitness, mental health, and more
* Daily lunch and dinner in our office
* Unlimited compute budget subject to ROI justification
* Unlimited Codex and Claude credits
* Travel

**How we're different**
-----------------------


Build believes in the Bitter Lesson. By taking a general approach of learning from humans, our addressable market is all physical labor.


We are a fully in\-person team in San Francisco (Financial District) and Shenzhen (Nanshan), and greatly value engineering skills. We do not have boundaries between engineering and research, and we expect all of our technical staff to contribute to both and work across disciplines as needed.


Build AI is an equal opportunity employer. We review every application. If you do not meet every bullet, still apply. Questions: research@build.ai


Compensation Range: $130K \- $180K

jobs.description:
Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU.


If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us.

* Note: This position requires presence in our San Francisco, San Jose, or Bellevue office location 4 days per week; Lambda’s designated work from home day is currently Tuesday.

  

The Technical Account Manager owns the technical health of the post\-sales relationship for Lambda’s public cloud accounts, spanning AI\-native startups, Enterprises, and Fortune 500 companies. Where the Customer Success Manager owns the commercial health of an account, you own its technical health: the customer’s workloads run well, the architecture is right, the SLA story is defensible, and technical risk is found and retired before it threatens revenue. Solutions Engineering carries the account through pre\-sales and hypercare; at handoff, you take ownership of the technical relationship for the life of the contract.


This is a hands\-on role, not a coordination role. You will understand what customers are actually building (training runs, fine\-tuning pipelines, inference services) deeply enough to lead joint POC sessions, design and defend architectures, validate SLA events at the root\-cause level, and build the tooling that makes account health measurable. You will be the customer’s most credible technical advocate inside Lambda and Lambda’s most trusted technical voice inside the account.

**What You’ll Do**

* Own the technical health of your accounts. Take the technical handoff from Solutions Engineering at the end of hypercare and own the account’s technical outcomes through steady state, expansion, and renewal. Know the state of every cluster and workload you are accountable for, and keep your commercial counterparts ahead of technical risk.
* Understand customer AI use cases end to end. Map what it means for each customer to train, fine\-tune, and serve models on Lambda: frameworks, schedulers, parallelism strategy, data paths, and performance baselines. Build the customer user journey and convert it into value\-add opportunities across the platform, documentation, and escalation routing.
* Lead joint customer POC sessions. Define success criteria with the customer before a node is provisioned: acceptance thresholds, benchmarks, timelines. Own the execution plan, coordinate capacity and provisioning, run or oversee the tests, and drive the POC to a clear verdict: win the workload, close the gap through product, or qualify out.
* Lead customer architecture designs. Produce and defend reference architectures spanning compute, networking, storage, connectivity, and scheduler integration (Slurm, Kubernetes). Make support boundaries explicit: what is managed and what is not. Own the design as it evolves after handoff, pulling in engineering domain experts with specific, well\-framed questions.
* Own SLA and reliability engineering. Build and own the canonical methodology for uptime, downtime, and credit calculation. Validate breach events at the technical level, down to the specific Ethernet or InfiniBand failure, and arm CSMs and leadership with defensible numbers. Partner with product to standardize SLA language and structure across 1CC, on\-demand, and reserved offerings.
* Build the tooling that makes accounts measurable. Own the technical data surfaces for customer health end to end: dashboards, telemetry and uptime history views, health scoring, and churn early\-warning signals. Scope, build, and drive adoption. Replace “escalate to engineering to answer a basic question” with self\-serve data for the whole GTM org.
* Direct technical escalations and incidents. Serve as the technical lead during high\-severity events on your accounts: drive root cause, hold the quality bar on RCAs, coordinate engineering, support, and vendors (NVIDIA, storage, networking), and give account teams a technically accurate narrative. Run proactive maintenance and known\-issue communication so customers hear about problems from Lambda first.
* Drive the technical voice of the customer. Run a structured feature\-request pipeline into product with committed triage timelines. Audit the platform hands\-on by provisioning as a customer and testing known friction points. Lead product\-led POCs (for example, NVIDIA NIM) that open new value for customers.
* Know the market technology landscape. Track GPU roadmaps, competing clouds and neoclouds, and the evolving training and inference stacks. Brief customers on what is coming and internal teams on where Lambda stands, and let that context shape architecture and expansion recommendations.

**You**

* 5\+ years in technical account management, solutions engineering or architecture, ML engineering, technical program or product management, or infrastructure engineering with significant customer\-facing scope, in cloud, HPC, or AI infrastructure.
* Hands\-on fluency with GPU infrastructure: able to provision, benchmark, and debug across compute, networking (InfiniBand, Ethernet), storage, and schedulers (Slurm, Kubernetes), and to read results critically.
* Working command of AI/ML workloads (training, fine\-tuning, inference) sufficient to map a customer’s stack, identify constraints, and lead technical conversations with their ML and infrastructure engineers.
* Track record leading structured technical engagements: POCs with defined success criteria, architecture designs, benchmark programs, or high\-severity escalations.
* A builder’s toolkit: scripting, SQL, and dashboarding, with a history of turning operational data into tools other people depend on.
