jobs.title: Sales Development Representative - Chicago
jobs.description:
**About the Team**
------------------



The In\-Store Sales Development team at DoorDash supports and scales the SevenRooms platform by connecting hospitality operators with powerful tools to own guest relationships and streamline in\-store operations. As part of DoorDash's broader sales organization, this team plays a critical role in driving top\-of\-funnel growth and building strong, hyper\-local relationships with restaurants across the U.S.


**About the Role**
------------------



As a **Sales Development Representative (SDR)**, you'll be the first point of contact for hospitality operators exploring SevenRooms and DoorDash's In\-Store solutions. You'll own the early stages of the sales process — researching prospects, identifying decision\-makers, qualifying interest, and securing meetings for field sales partners across your assigned region.



This role is ideal for someone who is energized by high\-volume outreach, enjoys uncovering opportunities through conversation, and wants to build a strong foundation in sales. You'll bring discipline and creativity to your outreach while gaining exposure to both inside and field sales motions within a fast\-paced, growth\-oriented environment.



You'll work closely with Sales leadership and field sellers to ensure a smooth handoff of qualified opportunities, while building core skills in prospecting, discovery, and storytelling.



We expect this role to be flexible, with some time in office and some time remote. You will need the ability to travel as needed for in\-person collaboration through trainings, offsites, team\-building events, and other business\-related necessities.


**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------


* **Prospect and qualify new merchants:** Identify, contact, and qualify hospitality operators and key decision\-makers through targeted outreach
* **Drive high\-volume outreach:** Conduct consistent cold calling (including high daily dial volume) and email outreach to generate interest and book qualified meetings
* **Partner with field sales:** Collaborate closely with outside sales partners to set meetings that move opportunities forward
* **Manage pipeline effectively:** Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records in Salesforce and internal tools to support clean handoffs and reporting
* **Refine sales skills:** Continuously improve messaging, discovery, and qualifying techniques through feedback and practice
* **Build industry knowledge:** Develop expertise in the SevenRooms platform, hospitality operations, and consultative selling

**We're excited about you because you have…**
---------------------------------------------


* **1\+ year of experience** in a sales or customer\-facing role; high\-volume outbound or cold calling experience is a strong plus
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to spark engaging conversations
* Comfort working in a fast\-paced, goal\-driven environment with daily activity targets
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail when managing leads and outreach
* Familiarity with CRM tools like Salesforce and productivity tools such as Google Workspace
* A proactive, coachable mindset with a desire to learn, adapt, and grow within a sales organization
* Interest in hospitality, restaurants, or technology\-enabled services

  



Notice to Applicants for Jobs Located in NYC or Remote Jobs Associated With Office in NYC Only



We use Covey as part of our hiring and/or promotional process for jobs in NYC and certain features may qualify it as an AEDT in NYC. As part of the hiring and/or promotion process, we provide Covey with job requirements and candidate submitted applications. We began using Covey Scout for Inbound from August 21, 2023, through December 21, 2023, and resumed using Covey Scout for Inbound again on June 29, 2024\.



The Covey tool has been reviewed by an independent auditor. Results of the audit may be viewed here: Covey

**About DoorDash**
------------------



At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door\-to\-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.  

  

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.


**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
---------------------------------------------



We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

* Competitive base salary \+ bonus \+ commission
* Clear **multi‑tier career path** with defined expectations and progression
* Best‑in‑class **sales training**, certifications, and ongoing development

* Portable, innovative sample systems that elevate the customer experience
* Strong company culture backed by award‑winning leadership


We design, manufacture, and stand behind products that set the standard in our industry—and our sales team sells with confidence knowing they’re backed by quality, innovation, and the industry’s best warranty.

* Educate and support contractors across Chicagoland so they choose Techo\-Bloc for their projects
* Build relationships that turn contractor demand into business for our dealer partners
* Support dealer merchandising, displays, and product training so our brand shows well at every stop
* Identify new business opportunities and stay ahead of the local competitive landscape
* Represent Techo\-Bloc at trade shows, dealer events, and industry gatherings throughout the region

  

**Qualifications** **What We're Looking For**

* A growth\-minded sales professional who wants to accelerate an already\-established territory with real scale and upside

jobs.description:
**Company Description** **About Syngenta**


At Syngenta Seeds Field Crops, we're shaping the future of agriculture and empowering farmers to meet the ever\-growing demand for food and fuel. We’re a global Ag Tech powerhouse, headquartered in the United States, with passionate, local experts collaborating with farmers to deliver solutions that create market opportunities. We unite precision breeding, advanced biotechnology trait choice, and digital platforms for unmatched in\-field performance. Our seeds help mitigate risks such as disease, insect, weed, and extreme weather pressures, all while promoting sustainable farming practices that protect and enhance our planet. Join our mission of revolutionizing food security and transforming agriculture.

 **Job Description**  

At Syngenta, our goal is to build the most collaborative and trustworthy team in agriculture, providing top\-quality seeds and innovative crop protection solutions that improve farmers' success. We invite you to help shape the future of agriculture and play a role in safely feeding the world while caring for our planet.


Syngenta's Sales Team is seeking a Seeds Agronomy Developmental Sales Representative. This internship role will be part of a high\-performing Sales Team and participate in a curriculum\-based, integrated learning opportunity preparing you to be a successful territory sales leader in the agriculture industry. You’ll receive competitive wages and ongoing career development resources.


As part of Syngenta's Emerging Talent Program, you will gain hands\-on experience, exposure to day\-to\-day business operations, and opportunities to apply your academic knowledge to real\-world challenges while developing your professional skills.

**Location:** Flexible locations within the United States (**Colorado, Illinois, Iowa, Kansas, Minnesota, Wisconsin, Oklahoma, Nebraska, Missouri, Indiana, Ohio, Michigan, North Dakota, South Dakota**)

**Accountabilities:**

* Complete a well\-defined, customized training and development plan with direction and assistance from your manager and experienced colleagues.
* Develop effective product and technical expertise, such as product placement, scouting, agronomic principles, building strong farmer relationships, understanding the sales process, and gaining product commitment.
* Gain experience and build leadership capabilities, consultative selling competence, communication and presentation skills, business acumen, and territory management while creating a professional network to further your career.
* Implement strategy to achieve sales objectives in the assigned territory.
* Identify and analyze customer needs, market intelligence, and territory opportunities to share with Sales Management and Marketing.
* Develop effective ways of working to strengthen teamwork within the sales team.
* Manage, support, and build the customer base in a defined geography.
* Advise channel partners on the presentation of products and promotional materials.
* Manage within territory budget guidance, accurately report expenses and sales, operate and maintain a company vehicle in compliance with policy, track customer interactions, and submit weekly activity reports.

  

**Qualifications** **Required Qualifications:**

* BA/BS degree completed between August 2026 and May 2027, preferably in Agricultural Science or a related field.
* A valid driver’s license and an acceptable moving violations record.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Experience with previous agricultural internships.
* First\-hand knowledge of farming is a definite asset.
* Knowledge of agronomics, general cropping practices, agricultural technology and trends, and requirements for pest control.
* Demonstrated professional and personal capabilities, such as:
	+ Strong customer focus
	+ Business acumen and results\-driven mindset
	+ Resilience and interpersonal savvy
	+ Ability to lead, be self\-directed, and work as part of a team
	+ Integrity and trust
	+ Effective writing, presentation, and negotiation skills
* Ability to be mobile within the Midwestern region of the U.S.

  

**Additional Information**  

Salary for this position ranges between $70,000 \- $75,000 annually.

**What We Offer:**

* A culture that celebrates belonging and collaboration, promotes professional development and strives for a work\-life balance that supports the team members.
* ⁠Competitive wages
* Ongoing career development resources
* The opportunity to work on meaningful, innovative projects that solve problems


Syngenta is committed to creating a culture that celebrates belonging and collaboration, promotes professional development, and strives for a work\-life balance that supports the team members


Syngenta has been ranked as a top employer by Science Journal. Learn more about our team and our mission here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=OVCN\_51GbNI

We are seeking a highly organized, personable, and data\-savvy Program Coordinator to lead our  

  

university partnerships, internship recruitment, and candidate experience initiatives. This role is both  

  

relationship\-driven and analytical: you'll be the primary point of contact for our university and

into insights that shape our strategy.

===============


New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. We build upon ideas that have guided generations, then share our discoveries to inspire generations to come. Your mission—your opportunity—is to seek out the answers that bring us one step closer. If you’re driven to discover, create, and inspire something that lasts a lifetime and beyond, you’re ready for JPL.


Located in Pasadena, California, JPL has a campus\-like environment situated on 177 acres in the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains and offers a work environment unlike any other: we inspire passion, foster innovation, build collaboration, and reward excellence.

**Responsibilities:**

NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) is seeking an enthusiastic, articulate, and highly organized **Academic Engagement Office Program Support person**. This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a unique office that manages education, research, and training programs for undergraduate, graduate, Ph.D., and postdoctoral fellows at JPL. The employee will work in the **Academic Engagement Office** supporting student internships and the postdoctoral fellowship program.

**Tasks include but are not limited to:**

* Facilitate logistical and administrative support for JPL’s student internship and postdoctoral fellowship programs, ensuring smooth day\-to\-day operations.

* Utilize and maintain internal data platforms (student and postdoc portal, Smartsheet, Microsoft Teams, Excel) to track program metrics and generate accurate reports.
* Identify opportunities to streamline internal processes and assist with implementing improvements.
* Represent programs at occasional offsite events requiring confident, professional engagement with the public.
* Ensure compliance with all institutional policies, partner agreements, and NASA\-specific regulatory requirements.
* Perform ad hoc duties as assigned.

* 0\-1 years of experience working in education, administration, communication or related environments.
* Demonstrated technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn new systems, tools, and platforms to support efficient program operations.

* Excellent customer service, organizational, interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills.
* Experience preparing presentations, reports, or briefing materials for stakeholders.

Adams and Central is an affordable housing community comprised of 80 units, in Los Angeles CA. Solari Enterprises, Inc. is a full\-service property management company with communities throughout California, specializing in all aspects of multifamily affordable housing since 1993\.

* Complete weekly, monthly, quarterly and annual reports

* Collect rents and handle delinquent accounts


**Required Qualifications:**

* Experience with supervising staff members

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook and the general computer skills
* Detail\-oriented

* Valid California driver’s license

* Bilingual fluency in Spanish and English
* Yardi program experience

* Certified Professional of Occupancy Certification (CPO)\- Section 8 only
* Specialist in Housing Credit Management Designation (SHCM)\- Section 42 only
* Registered Apartment Manager (RAM) Certification
* Fair Housing Coordinator (FHC) Certification

* $27\.00/hr
* 3\-bedroom unit included
* Paid Holidays, Vacation and Sick Time
* Benefits
* Matching 401k (Employer Match)

* Collaborate closely with other internal stakeholders to execute with LCCs around tentpole events (e.g. Super Bowl, Combine, Draft, Pro Bowl, etc.)
* Stay up to date with industry standards and best practices
* Thoroughly track the LCC program’s activity in partnership with key groups including: publishing of LCC content, consumption / engagement of LCC content, attributable revenue, etc.

* Thorough understanding of social media platforms such as Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, Snapchat, TikTok, etc.

* Thorough knowledge of the National Football League, associated events and storylines
* Meticulous attention to detail and high level of resourcefulness

* Experience with communication platform Slack

* Ability to work non\-traditional hours, including nights and weekends
* Capacity to work independently with limited direction
* Strong organizational skills

**About the Role**

A leading wholesaler and distributor of petroleum products is seeking a full\-time, detail\-oriented Logistics Operations Coordinator to join its dispatch and operations team. This is an excellent opportunity for an organized, self\-motivated professional to grow within a well\-established company that offers a casual yet professional working environment.

**Schedule**

This position follows a variable schedule that includes both morning and afternoon shifts, Monday through Friday. Occasional on\-call availability is required to respond to carrier and customer inquiries during evenings and weekends.

**What We're Looking For**

We're looking for an organized, dedicated professional with a positive attitude who learns quickly and thrives in a fast\-paced, multitasking environment. Strong attention to detail and accuracy is essential. The ideal candidate is proactive and self\-driven — someone who takes initiative to help the team meet deadlines, deliver excellent customer service, and continuously improve processes and efficiency. This person is a flexible team player, entrepreneurial in mindset, and motivated to improve every process they touch. Strong candidates seeking to advance their career will find this a great next step.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage daily order processing, scheduling, and logistics coordination

new_jobs.title: Content Marketing Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Content Marketing Manager

**Company:** Tacos 1986

**Location:** Los Angeles, CA (In\-field \& On\-site)

**Compensation:** $75,000 Starting Base Salary

**Who We Are**

Tacos 1986 brings the unfiltered, high\-energy experience of a Tijuana street taqueria straight to Los Angeles. We’re known for our trompo, fresh\-pressed masa, and cult\-favorite menu that communities love. We don’t do boring corporate food. We create real, raw, fast\-paced culinary experiences across our brick\-and\-mortar locations, major music festivals, pop\-ups, catering events, and private activations.

**The Role**

We’re looking for a dynamic storyteller, content strategist, and brand\-minded creator to become the in\-house documentarian of Tacos 1986\. The scope of the role will continue to evolve alongside the company.

This is much more than scheduling social posts. You’ll be capturing taqueros slicing adobada off the trompo, documenting festival load\-ins, building our YouTube presence, highlighting parts of the brand our audience may not know about, and helping turn our social reach into real\-world awareness, catering leads, and event opportunities.

You’ll work closely with our marketing team to ensure all content supports the larger marketing calendar, campaigns, promotions, partnerships, and overall brand direction. While there will always be opportunities to capture spontaneous moments, this role requires **proactive planning, scheduling, and pre\-production of shoots** so we consistently have the right content for upcoming initiatives.

**What You Will Do**

* **Produce Weekly Social Content:** Shoot, edit, deliver and post approximately **4–5 high\-energy short\-form videos per week** for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and other social platforms. Shoot accompanying photography when needed for marketing initiatives.
* **Plan \& Schedule Content Shoots:** Work ahead of the marketing calendar to identify content needs, coordinate locations and talent, build shot lists, and schedule dedicated shoot days for upcoming campaigns, menu launches, partnerships, and events.
* **Partner With the Marketing Team:** Work closely with marketing to ensure content remains aligned with Tacos 1986’s brand identity, campaign priorities, promotions, partnerships, and business objectives.
* **Build the YouTube Channel:** Develop longer\-form vlogs, mini\-documentaries, behind\-the\-scenes features, and recurring concepts showcasing ingredient sourcing, festival load\-ins, restaurant culture, events, and the people behind Tacos 1986\.
* **Own the Narrative:** Capture the grit, personality, and energy behind the brand—from early\-morning prep and busy restaurant services to weekend pop\-ups and large\-scale festival activations across Southern California.
* **Expand Brand Awareness:** Create dedicated content around offerings our audience may not fully know about, including happy hour, breakfast, catering, new menu initiatives, special events, and other emerging programs.
* **Create Product\-Focused Stories:** Develop content around individual menu items, ingredients, and signature products—from specific tacos and proteins to Salsa Macha and other elements that make Tacos 1986 distinctive.
* **Support Catering \& Events:** Create content designed to generate awareness and inbound interest for catering, private events, festivals, and brand activations, while helping track social\-generated opportunities.
* **Grow With the Brand:** As new initiatives launch, help develop the content strategy, storytelling approach, and content systems needed to introduce and support them. Also supporting content for the New York location and Las Vegas location(will require travel).

**What You Bring**

* Proven experience shooting and editing compelling, fast\-paced video content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube, and similar platforms.
* Strong instincts for storytelling, pacing, hooks, editing, and identifying moments that audiences actually want to watch.
* A strategic mindset and an understanding that content should support broader marketing and business objectives—not just generate views.
* Strong organizational and production\-planning skills, including the ability to schedule shoots, develop shot lists, anticipate upcoming content needs, and work from a marketing calendar.
* The ability to collaborate closely with a marketing team while also independently identifying strong content opportunities.
* Comfort working in loud, chaotic, fast\-moving environments including kitchens, festivals, pop\-ups, events, and late\-night restaurant rushes.
* Flexibility to occasionally shoot outside traditional office hours when festivals, events, restaurant services, or other brand moments require it.
* Bilingual Spanish/English is highly preferred to communicate naturally and authentically with our back\-of\-house team.

**Compensation \& Perks**

* $75,000 starting base salary
* Potential travel to pop ups around the world, to any store outside California like Las Vegas and New York.
* Entry to all our festivals and events
* In\-house equipment allowance to build out your run\-and\-gun content gear
* Shift meals

* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule

new_jobs.description:
Hajoca Corporation is one of the country’s largest privately\-held wholesale distributors of plumbing, heating \& cooling, and industrial supplies. Founded in 1858, Hajoca is a company based on the principles of “Service, Integrity, Reliability,” and on relationships of trust and support with teammates, customers, and suppliers. Throughout its history, Hajoca has played an active role in shaping advances in plumbing. However, we attribute our success to two simple truths; a unique business philosophy and talented people. Hajoca is all about the people, who give us our advantage, and who will guide us successfully into the future.
  
  

Although Hajoca is a large company, we work in a decentralized environment where each of our locations, called Profit Centers (PCs), is run by the Profit Center Manager as if it were their own small business. A typical Profit Center is the heart of our business and consists of a warehouse, counter, sales office, and (sometimes) a showroom. Our PCs conduct business under unique trade names and offer a customized business approach, honoring what’s special about each local marketplace.
  
  

Hajoca is one of those trade names and is looking for an Inside Sales \& Service Representative at their Costa Mesa, CA location.
  
  

Pay for Inside Sales \& Service Representative is between $20 and $30 per hour at this location.
  
  

Do you take pride in providing an excellent customer experience? Are you outgoing, knowledgeable, and service\-oriented? Do you have the determination to close sales and build lasting relationships with new and existing customers? If so, we’d like you to join our team as an Inside Sales \& Service Representative.

* Demonstrate product knowledge to answer customer questions and identify opportunities to upsell or cross sell.
* Build influential relationships and trust with customers and vendors through open and interactive communication.

new_jobs.description:
**At Swoop, our mission is simple:** Improving patient outcomes. As a market leader in AI\-driven, data\-powered, and privacy\-compliant healthcare engagement, we connect the signals that drive earlier diagnosis, better treatment decisions, and sustained adherence.
  
  

Our integrated, privacy\-safe platform, enables life sciences companies to drive measurable patient and commercial outcomes with actionable intelligence — spanning patient and HCP audience targeting, community engagement, AI\-powered web solutions, coordinated omnichannel activation, and prescription fulfillment.
  
  

We believe our people are our greatest asset. Swoop fosters a culture of innovation and continuous learning, providing employees with rich opportunities for professional growth. This commitment to our team earned us the "Best Places to Work" recognition from Business Intelligence Group in 2025 and 2026\. We are driven by a patient\-first philosophy and passionate about leveraging technology to create a healthier future.
  
  

After becoming an independent company in 2024, Swoop experienced significant growth and demonstrated an unwavering commitment to innovation, talent development, and enhancing the patient experience. Our acquisition of MyHealthTeam in January 2025 and Nimble in May 2026 helped us further bridging the gap between healthcare brands and patients for more impactful and targeted engagement. Empowering millions of patients nationwide to connect, share resources, and access medically verified information to better manage their health. MyHealthTeam hosts the largest and most engaged patient social networks in healthcare, offering more than 70 condition\-specific communities for chronic and rare conditions. As a prescription fulfillment and patient engagement platform, Nimble empowers independent and regional pharmacies to deliver a modern, consumer\-friendly healthcare experience while streamlining pharmacy operations.
  
  

If you're a driven professional seeking to make a real difference in healthcare marketing at a fast\-growing, innovative company, join Swoop and help us revolutionize how brands connect with patients and HCPs.
  
  

About the role
  
  

NimbleRx is looking for a motivated and ambitious Sales Development Representative from the tech/healthcare space to join our growing Sales Team. As an SDR, you will be the first point of contact for potential pharmacy partners and play a crucial role in driving our sales pipeline.
  
  

In this role, you will be responsible for scheduling appointments for our Account Executives to demo our product for local and regional pharmacy groups. The ideal candidate is a self\-starter with an ability to adapt quickly and a team player with a passion for making an impact and building a career in a SaaS sales role!
  
  

What you'll do
  
  

Drive strategic outreach (cold calling, email campaigns, etc.) to large pharmacy groups to determine decision\-makers within target pharmacies.
  
Employ effective selling techniques including research, building rapport, productive questions, and issue identification.
  
Build relationships with pharmacy owners/decision\-makers to establish trust and confidence in NimbleRx's exciting tech\-driven product.
  
Schedule product demos for Account Executives and ensure prospects are prepared and engaged for the next steps in the sales process.
  
Work closely with the Sales and Marketing teams to align messaging, strategies, and goals for optimal outreach.
  
Maintain accurate records of prospect interactions, track progress, and update lead statuses in our CRM (Customer Relationship Management) system, Salesforce.
  
Develop strategic account and opportunity insights by analyzing previously closed opportunities, historical conversation notes, and customer feedback to identify patterns, barriers, and high\-potential paths to engagement.
  
Lead thoughtful, research\-driven prospecting by incorporating pharmacy\-specific insights, including public reviews and customer sentiment, into personalized outreach and precall strategies.
  
  

Qualifications
  
  

1 or more years of tech sales experience
  
Experience in the tech/healthcare space
  
A passion for working directly with customers and making an impact
  
A positive attitude and an ability to work in a fast\-paced, constantly evolving environment
  
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  
A bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
  
  

This role offers a base salary plus uncapped commission.

Graduate Program Coordinator, Biosciences (5156C) \#88591 About Berkeley
  
  

At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation \- driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  

At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full\-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  

We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  

Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  

Departmental Overview
  
  

The Departments of Molecular and Cell Biology (MCB), Integrative Biology (IB), and Neuroscience (NEU) are among the largest academic departments at UC Berkeley. By several measures (including number of faculty and students, budget, and assigned square feet), these departments are larger than many UCB colleges and schools.
  
  

The three departments represent over 186 faculty FTE (including Adjuncts, Professors of the Graduate School, active emeriti, and 21 HHMI professors); 140 Researchers and Specialists; 185 post\-doctoral researchers; 350 graduate students; 2,100 undergraduate students; 60 department staff members; and a total state and extramural payroll of approximately 1,450 (including Graduate Student Instructors, Graduate Student Researchers, and research staff).
  
  

Financial resources include approximately $90M in annual extramural funding (which accounts for over half of the total sponsored research awards in the College of Letters \& Science) and over $91M other fund sources. Department personnel are currently housed in eight buildings located in three widely separated parts of the campus.
  
  

Position Summary
  
  

The Graduate Program Coordinator provides a wide range of student services to the Graduate Affairs Office in support of the Integrative Biology and Molecular \& Cell Biology Ph.D. programs. This position leads projects while collaborating with and supporting team members, faculty, and students. The Graduate Program Coordinator manages large\-scale events and projects, including recruitment, commencement, and Graduate Student Instructor (GSI) hiring, as well as smaller\-scale events such as orientation and regular student programming. Additionally, this position provides administrative and operational support in areas such as communications, student advising, data collection and analysis, and student reimbursement processing.
  
  

Application Review Date
  
  

The First Review Date for this job is September 14, 2026\. For full consideration, please apply by the first review date.
  
  

Responsibilities

new_jobs.description:
**About Build AI**
------------------


Build AI is the data hyperscaler for Physical AI. We're vertically integrated across hardware, manufacturing, logistics, collection, and model training to scale the physical labor dataset orders of magnitude faster than anyone in the world.

**About the Role**
------------------


We're looking for our first Events \& Field Marketing Manager to build Build's events function from scratch.


You'll own how Build shows up in the world: the conferences we sponsor, the events we host around them, and the standalone experiences we create for customers, prospects, candidates, and the broader physical AI community.


This is a strategy **and** execution role. You'll decide where Build should invest, develop creative ways to stand out, and personally make the details happen. One week that might mean planning Build's presence at NeurIPS or CoRL; the next it could mean putting together an intimate dinner for AI researchers, a recruiting event in San Francisco, or an event format we haven't tried before.


You'll have significant autonomy, budget, and responsibility for representing Build externally.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Build and own Build's events calendar and strategy from scratch.
* Own Build's presence at major AI and robotics conferences, including sponsorships, attendance, activations, and related events.
* Create and execute standalone events for customers, prospects, candidates, and the AI and robotics community \- including events ranging from executive dinners and small gatherings to recruiting events, conferences, launches, and larger experiences.
* Identify which conferences and events Build should invest in based on customer, recruiting, and brand impact.
* Develop creative concepts that make Build memorable and differentiated rather than simply showing up with a booth.
* Own events end\-to\-end: concept, venue, vendors, contracts, budgets, guest lists, invitations, logistics, onsite execution, and follow\-up.
* Measure what works and turn successful experiments into repeatable programs.
* Build the systems and operating processes required to scale the function as Build grows.

**You May Be a Good Fit If You**
--------------------------------

* Have **2\+ years of experience** in events, field marketing, experiential marketing, or a related role.
* Have personally owned conferences, sponsored events, dinners, or other in\-person experiences from concept through execution.
* Are exceptionally organized and detail oriented. You can run several complex projects simultaneously without dropping things.
* Have high agency. When something needs to happen, your instinct is to figure out how to make it happen rather than wait for instructions.
* Are creative and have strong taste. You care about creating experiences people actually remember.
* Are scrappy. You're equally comfortable negotiating a major sponsorship and fixing a last\-minute problem yourself five minutes before an event starts.
* Exercise excellent judgment and can represent Build confidently with customers, researchers, candidates, executives, and partners.
* Thrive in ambiguity and like building things from zero rather than inheriting established processes.
* Are willing to travel regularly for conferences and events.

**Even Better If**
------------------

* You've worked at a fast\-growing startup and know what it means to operate without much infrastructure.
* You have experience in AI, technology, robotics, or another technical industry.
* You've built an events or field marketing program rather than only executing an existing playbook.
* You've found unconventional ways to create memorable events without simply spending more money.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------


Build becomes one of the companies people consistently notice at the most important AI and robotics gatherings.


Our customers and prospects want to attend our events. Great candidates encounter Build through experiences that make them want to join. Our conference investments produce real relationships and opportunities. And behind the scenes, the entire program runs with exceptional operational discipline.


You turn events into a competitive advantage for Build to scale recruiting, brand, and customer acquisition.

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive pay
* Medical, dental, and vision packages with generous premium coverage
* $500 per month credit for waiving medical benefits
* Housing subsidy of $2k per month for those living within walking distance of the office
* Relocation support for those moving to San Francisco (Financial District) or Shenzhen (Nanshan)
* Various wellness benefits covering fitness, mental health, and more
* Daily lunch and dinner in our office
* Unlimited compute budget subject to ROI justification
* Unlimited Codex and Claude credits
* Travel

**How we're different**
-----------------------


Build believes in the Bitter Lesson. By taking a general approach of learning from humans, our addressable market is all physical labor.


We are a fully in\-person team in San Francisco (Financial District) and Shenzhen (Nanshan), and greatly value engineering skills. We do not have boundaries between engineering and research, and we expect all of our technical staff to contribute to both and work across disciplines as needed.


Build AI is an equal opportunity employer. We review every application. If you do not meet every bullet, still apply. Questions: research@build.ai


Compensation Range: $130K \- $180K

**Position Summary**



The Clinic Operations Assistant (COA) provides operational and administrative support to ensure the efficient daily functioning of the clinic. The COA serves as the primary administrative contact for clients, clinicians, and program staff and is responsible for coordinating front office operations, scheduling support, record management, and administrative processes that support clinical service delivery.



COAs work collaboratively with clinicians and supervisors to maintain organized clinic operations while ensuring a welcoming, professional, and efficient environment for clients and staff.

  

**Minimum Qualifications**


* At least three years of administrative support, front\-office, or office operations experience; healthcare, behavioral health, or medical\-office experience preferred.
* Demonstrated experience with scheduling, client reception, records management, data entry, and confidential information.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, scheduling systems, and electronic health record or insurance\-eligibility systems.
* Strong organizational, communication, customer\-service, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced clinic environment.
* Ability to maintain a regular, full\-time onsite Monday\-Friday schedule, with occasional evening work as needed.
* Ability to complete required background clearances, health screening, and TB testing, consistent with organizational policy.
  


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Associate degree in business administration, healthcare administration, health information, or a related field.
* Experience in a behavioral health, healthcare, or medical\-office setting.
* Experience with insurance eligibility verification, authorizations, encounter reporting, or billing support.
* Experience using InSync or another electronic health record system.
* Valid California driver’s license and current auto insurance, if regular travel between sites is required.
  


**Key Responsibilities**

  

**1\. Client Scheduling and Appointment Coordination**



The COA supports clinicians by coordinating and managing appointment scheduling for outpatient services.



Responsibilities include:


* Scheduling client appointments in the clinic scheduling system based on clinician availability and treatment plans.
* Coordinating appointment times between clients and clinicians.
* Managing appointment changes, cancellations, and rescheduling requests.
* Monitoring clinician schedules for openings or conflicts.
* Communicating scheduling updates to clinicians and clients as needed.
* Maintaining accurate scheduling records through Insync database.
* Supporting client reminders and follow\-up communication when appropriate.


**Clinical decisions regarding treatment frequency, session length, and scheduling availability remain the responsibility of the clinician.**

  

**2\. Front Desk and Client Reception**


* Greet clients in a warm, professional manner upon arrival.
* COA electronically checks clients in and notify clinicians when their client has arrived.

At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. new_jobs.title: Research Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Job ID: 1165654\_RR00123127


Facility: NYU Grossman School of Medicine


Position Type: Full\-Time/Regular


Shift: Day


Schedule: Monday\-Friday; 9:00AM\-5:00PM


Department: Research, IBD Research (S2006\), NYU Grossman School of Medicine,


  
NYU Grossman School of Medicine is one of the nation’s top\-ranked medical schools. For 175 years, NYU Grossman School of Medicine has trained thousands of physicians and scientists who have helped to shape the course of medical history and enrich the lives of countless people. An integral part of NYU Langone Health, the Grossman School of Medicine at its core is committed to improving the human condition through medical education, scientific research, and direct patient care. At NYU Langone Health, equity and inclusion are fundamental values. We strive to be a place where our exceptionally talented faculty, staff, and students of all identities can thrive. We embrace inclusion and individual skills, ideas, and knowledge.


For more information, go to med.nyu.edu, and interact with us on LinkedIn, Glassdoor, Indeed, Facebook, X and Instagram.


**Position Summary:**  

We have an exciting opportunity to join our team as a Research Coordinator.


In this role, the successful candidate will be responsible for providing basic to moderate range of coordination for Research studies conducted at the Medical Center. Assists with recruitment, enrollment, grant submissions, research data collection and study coordination. Performs intra\-operative monitoring and serves as liaison with the IRB and the internal and external funding agencies. Ensures accurate execution of research protocols in accordance with Good Clinical Practices, HIPAA and required obligations to patient/subject, Principal Investigator, research team and sponsor. Interfaces directly with patients/subjects and Principal Investigators in support of the clinical trials if applicable. Works under general supervision.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Study Regulations – Aware of study regulatory status and keeps an up to date copy of regulatory documents. Assists with the informed consent process and ensure that the patient/subject fully understands what is required of them throughout the study. Follows through regularly with the patient/subjects and reminds them of visits and compliance.
* Clinical Competency: Position may require competency in performing EKG, phlebotomy technique, centrifuge, handling, storing and shipping of specimens. Clinical training and didactic competency tests may be required to perform basic procedures as part of position expectations. In house training and certification will be provided. Other trainings and competencies may be included as required.
* Continuous Learning: Position requires ongoing continuing education in all areas of research development. It is expected that the employee demonstrates proof of ongoing research education on a yearly basis. Training programs are provided through the SOM.
* Reporting and Analysis – Gathers and compiles data and assists in consolidating/analyzing data for presentation to sponsoring and regulatory agencies. Provides reports to all necessary parties (e.g., the principal investigator, sponsoring agency, etc.) on the progress of the study as needed. Conduct primary analysis to data collected. Formulates, prepares database and generates preliminary measurement reports for review by the PI.
* Grants – Assists in the preparation of grant applications and related activities such as developing grants proposals and fund raising activities. Collects and organizes required paperwork for submission if required. Follows up and coordinates resolution of all issues progress reports to the sponsors to fund medical research in the division.
* Budgets – May develop draft budgets and submit to the Principal Investigator. Assists in the preparation of funding reports to agencies. Helps to identify new potential sponsors/agents for trials and researches as assigned.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as required.
* Human Subjects’ Research – If applicable, updates and submits necessary documents required by the NYU Institutional Board (IRB), NYU Office of Clinical Trials and any other appropriate parties in order to obtain approval to conduct human subjects research. Secures accurate signatures and forwards documents and/or forms to appropriate destination. Might prepare and submit monthly enrollment statistics to the Office of Clinical Trials and provide other information in timely manner, as necessary.
* Research Activities – Collects patient information for the research project(s). This may include abstraction of data from the patient chart (e.g., laboratory or diagnostic test results, surgical/radiation treatments delivered, adverse drug reactions, etc); abstraction of data for publications, or data collection from outside physicians offices. Uses tools to facilitate data collection (e.g. calendars, schedules, tracking logs, etc). Audits and updates the database or the case report forms. Conducts study visits, obtains and documents information within the time frame specified. Research, collects, compiles and conducts preliminary analyses of data, statistics, and other materials for reports. Conduct preliminary analysis.
* Recruitment – Screens potential patients/subjects for eligibility to the study and schedules the initial visits. This may include researching and gathering information from the medical record, physician referral, advertisement and directly scheduling a visit to evaluate the patient/subject. Reviews all the elements of the screening process with the Principal Investigator that include but not limited to: inclusion/exclusion criteria, completed informed consent, documentation of the event and the patient/subject willingness to participate in the study.

**Minimum Qualifications:**  

To qualify you must have a Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, allied health or equivalent in a related discipline

new_jobs.title: Community Coordinator - Martin Van Buren High School (26Q435)
new_jobs.description:
**Community Coordinator \- Martin Van Buren High School (26Q435\)**
===================================================================


* Posted Date: Sep 1, 2026 Deadline: Sep 15, 2026
**Job Details**
---------------


### **Position Summary:**


Under the supervision of the Principal, the Community Coordinator will perform duties related to developing and improving community relations. The Community Coordinator will support the school in its efforts to increase and maintain communication between the school and our students, families, staff, and community partners and other community organizations and high schools and colleges. The Community Coordinator will similarly work to develop and sustain positive relations with other schools in the community and other organizations within the NYC Department of Education. The Community Coordinator will also work with local businesses, corporations and community\-based organizations to solicit interest in supporting and/or providing sites for the school’s fieldwork, internship, community service or community farming programs. Current groups working with the school include: Commonpoint. Performs related work.


### **Reports to:**


Principal Uchechukwu Njoku


### **Key Relationships:**


Serves as a liaison between school administration and community groups by coordinating and facilitating communication between the school, staff, students, families, community organizations, businesses, government agencies and the communities that these vital organizations represent.


### **Responsibilities**


* Maintains ongoing contact with community based organizations (CBO’s) that are involved with providing services to support the school’s educational programs.
* Assists students and staff in building relationships with external partners including those connected to the school.
* Meets with community leaders and the administration to plan community events.
* Meets regularly and communicate with community partners to schedule a calendar of events for the fiscal year.
* Coordinates and supervises various outreach programs between the school and the neighboring community.
* Responsible for the supervision, planning, implementation, coordination, and monitoring of community development programs.
* Develops, coordinates and monitors partnerships and community development programs associated with the PTA and CBO’s.
* Prepares evaluation reports; performs analyses; and reviews program plans, funding and performance with various CBO’s.
* Works with our various departments and Parent Association to support and develop the community workshops.
* Prepares correspondence, documents, and other forms of written communication for internal and external community outreach purposes.
* Provides logistical and administrative support to the Parent Coordinator and the Principal related to community outreach and parent engagement.
* Encourages participation from the school’s community groups in recreational activities and assists with the provision of related operational support including outreach to community agencies.

### **Qualification Requirements:**


#### **Minimum**


* A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college and two years of experience in community work or community centered activities in an area related to the duties described above; or


* High school graduation or equivalent and six years of experience in community work or community centered activities in an area related to the duties as described above; or


* Education and/or experience which is equivalent to **"1"** or **"2"** above. However, all candidates must have at least one year of experience as described in **"1"** above.


#### **Preferred**


* Public speaking ability and good people skills.
* Ability to interact with people of all social and economic levels.
* Prior experience in school setting and interaction with students, parents, and school staff.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
* Ability to work with students, teachers, and supervisors.
* Knowledge of school program objectives.
* Strong literacy skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex issues when necessary.

### **Work Schedule:**


This is a 12 month, 35 hour per week annual assignment. Position will require flexibility with respect to work hours in order to meet the needs of the school community, including early mornings, evenings and weekends. Use of earned vacation and/or compensatory time is subject to approval of school principal.


### **Salary:**


$62,707 (New Hire Rate)


$72,114 \- $97,343 (Incumbent \- 2 years of full\-time continuous City service)


### **Application:**


Please send cover letter and resume, no later than **9/15/2026**, to:


Sara Bezler


Email:**SBezler@schools.nyc.gov**

  

**NOTE: The filling of all positions is subject to budget availability.**

Join JPMorgan Chase's Risk Management and Compliance team, where your expertise will drive the re\-engineering of how model risk is managed across the firm. new_jobs.title: HR Operations Manager and Executive Assistant to the CHRO
new_jobs.description:
Position Summary:

The Council on Foreign Relations (CFR) is seeking an organized and proactive HR Operations Manager and Executive Assistant to the CHRO. In this dual\-function role, this person will serve as a central coordination point for the HR department including triaging communications, ensuring information flows smoothly, and connecting the right people to the right information. This role will manage and track cross\-functional HR projects and initiatives, support logistics for learning and engagement events, organize team meetings, and capture clear meeting notes that keep the team aligned. This role also acts as a key liaison across HR sub\-groups and between CFR’s offices, fostering cohesion and operational consistency throughout the department.


As Executive Assistant to the CHRO, this role will provide high\-quality, confidential administrative support including calendar management, travel coordination, expense and invoice processing, and meeting preparation. This role serves as a trusted partner to the CHRO, helping to protect her time, proactively anticipate her needs, and ensure she is positioned for success.


As this role is a key presence for the department, you will work full\-time onsite in CFR’s New York office. This position requires a high level of discretion and confidentiality and the ability to manage relationships both internally and externally.


Essential Functions/Responsibilities:
* Act as first point of contact for Human Resources department and CHRO, triaging inquiries and directing employees to the appropriate HR resource in a timely and professional manner,
* Manage action items for the HR leadership team; track priorities, projects, and department wide timelines to ensure cohesion across HR sub\-teams,
* Support the documentation and continuous improvement of HR operational processes and standard operating procedures to drive efficiency and consistency across the department,
* Manage HR department calendar and team meetings; take minutes and circulate notes to team; outline and coordinate action items,
* Support event logistics for HR events, including engagement programming and trainings,
* Manage executive support to the CHRO including, but not limited to: calendar management, expense reports processing, contract review, invoices processing, travel schedule arrangement, and document management,
* Attend meetings with CHRO, when appropriate, and take notes for follow\-up and/or circulation,
* Draft communications and/or other documents for CHRO such as status updates on projects or meeting minutes,
* Provide a bridge for smooth communication between the office of the CHRO and leaders and staff across the organization; foster important internal and external relationships that facilitate departmental success,
* Support HR team with coverage for in\-person events, candidate interviews, or other all\-hands\-on\-deck situations,
* Perform any other duties or tasks as assigned or required.


Minimum Qualifications:
**Experience**

* At least 5 years of relevant experience, including experience working cross\-functionally and project coordination
* Bachelor's degree preferred, but not required
* HR experience preferred, but not required

**Related Skills \& Other Requirements**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Demonstrated attention to detail
* Superb customer service skills across all levels of the organization and with external stakeholders
* Excellent organization and multitasking skills, with demonstrated proactive ownership and accountability
* Proven ability to work in a fast\-paced environment, both independently and as part of a team
* Able to make decisions and handle sensitive and confidential HR information using sound judgment and discretion
* Effective problem\-solving capabilities; ability to anticipate patterns and links; looks beyond the immediate problem to the wider implications
* Advanced knowledge of Outlook and Microsoft Suite
* Experience with ATS or CRM systems are a plus
* Qualified candidates will have related experience that required judgment, strong writing and editing ability, the ability to prioritize, and experience interacting with various stakeholders from staff to candidates to executive team members


Required Application Materials:
* Please submit a résumé and cover letter stating your interest in the position.


Compensation and Benefits:
* The full\-time annual compensation range for this position is 90,000\-$100,000, depending on experience.
* In addition to competitive salaries, CFR provides employees with an outstanding benefits package.

  


About CFR:

The Council on Foreign Relations (CFR) is committed to fostering a foreign policy community in the United States that is more representative of American society, recognizing that diverse backgrounds and perspectives contribute to broader, more informed participation in the foreign policy debate and lead to an enhanced understanding of the world and the United States’ role therein. To that end, CFR is dedicated to continuing to advance diversity, equity, and inclusion throughout its work and workplace by building a more diverse membership and staff, producing and dispensing thoughtful analysis on a broad range of foreign policy issues, and developing relevant, wide\-reaching programming that also serves to expand the foreign policy talent pipeline to underrepresented populations.

new_jobs.description:

The Business Development Representative (also known as a Sales Development Representative) engages with stakeholders to address their concerns about investment reporting accuracy and timeliness. new_jobs.description:
**Part\-Time Social Media Manager**

**Le Relais de Venise l’Entrecôte \- Midtown Manhattan**

Le Relais de Venise l'Entrecôte is looking for a creative and energetic **Part\-Time Social Media Manager** to manage and grow the social presence of our New York City restaurant.

Known for our classic French steak\-frites experience and distinctive approach to dining, we’re looking for someone who can capture what makes l’Entrecôte special and translate it into engaging, authentic social content.

The Role

This is a hands\-on, part\-time position. You’ll spend time at our Midtown Manhattan restaurant creating content as well as planning, editing, posting, and engaging with our audience.

Responsibilities include:

* Creating original content for Instagram, TikTok, Reels, and Stories
* Visiting the restaurant regularly to photograph and film food, service, atmosphere, and behind\-the\-scenes moments
* Shooting and editing engaging short\-form videos
* Developing a consistent weekly content calendar
* Writing captions and publishing posts
* Keeping up with relevant social trends while maintaining the identity and heritage of the restaurant
* Responding to comments and engaging with our online community
* Identifying opportunities for collaborations, influencers, events, and local NYC content
* Reviewing analytics and identifying which content performs best
* Developing ideas that increase awareness, engagement, and ultimately encourage people to visit the restaurant

**We’re looking for someone who is:**

* Creative and full of content ideas
* Comfortable filming and photographing in a busy restaurant
* Experienced with Instagram and TikTok
* Comfortable editing short\-form video
* Organized and able to work independently
* Familiar with NYC food, restaurant, and hospitality culture
* Able to balance current social trends with an established restaurant brand
* Available to work on\-site in Midtown Manhattan as needed

Previous restaurant, hospitality, food, lifestyle, or social media experience is strongly preferred.

Position

**Part\-time**  
**Location:** Midtown Manhattan, New York City  
**Work arrangement:** Combination of on\-site content creation and remote planning/editing

How to Apply

Please send us:

* A short introduction
* Your resume or relevant experience
* Links to social accounts you currently manage or have managed
* Examples of Reels, TikToks, photography, or other content you’ve created
* Your availability
* Your expected hourly rate or part\-time compensation

We’re especially interested in seeing your actual work. A traditional resume is helpful, but a strong portfolio and a good understanding of social media are even more important.

Pay: $25\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 10\.0 – 12\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Hybrid remote in New York, NY 10022

new_jobs.title: Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
Description:
**Aria Care Partners** is the national leader in providing onsite dental, vision, hearing, and podiatry care to over 3500 long\-term care and skilled nursing facilities across 25 states. Aria Care Partners believes that our clinicians should be able to focus on providing the best, most comprehensive care for their patients. Our clinicians visit different skilled nursing communities daily, bringing life\-affirming care to an underserved population. Our business model, innovation, customer support and teamwork deliver an unparalleled customer experience, resulting in a customer satisfaction rating of over 98%. Executing this strategic philosophy resulted in rapid company growth with revenue increases of 25%\-30% annually over the last 4 years, nearly doubling the size of the company. Company values include caring fully for our customers and fellow employees, striving for excellence and continuous improvement, and excelling through the power of teamwork and collaboration. At Aria Care Partners, our mission is to enrich the quality of life for every resident with passion and compassion.

**Working at Aria Matters!**

**The Position**


We’re looking for an Account Manager who would enjoy working for a company that makes a difference in the geriatric population’s lives in communities across the nation. The primary function of this position is to provide excellent customer service, retention of existing accounts, and insurance sales.

* Retention of existing facilities: Sustains rapport with key accounts by making periodic visits – at a minimum once per quarter; exploring specific needs; anticipating new opportunities.
* Achieves marketing and sales operational objectives by contributing marketing and sales information and recommendations to strategic plans and reviews; preparing and completing action plans; implementing quality and customer\-service standards; resolving problems; completing audits; identifying trends; determining system improvements; implementing change.
* Identifies marketing opportunities by identifying consumer requirements; defining market, competitor's share, and competitor's strengths and weaknesses; forecasting projected business; establishing targeted market share.
* Accomplishes organization goals by accepting ownership for accomplishing new and different requests; exploring opportunities to add value to job accomplishments.
* Keeps promotional materials ready by coordinating requirements with marketing department; inventorying stock; placing orders; verifying receipt.
* Plans meetings and attends trade shows
* Protects organization's value by keeping information confidential

**The Location**


The Account Manager position is a remote position that includes a combination of field days and home office days. **This role REQUIRES overnight travel and** **the individual MUST reside within the territory.**


Requirements:
* Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred
* 3\-5 Years previous applicable experience
* Preferred prior work experience within senior living communities, sales, and life/health insurance
* Ability to obtain health and life insurance license
* Reliable transportation
* Ability to Lift Up to 50 Pounds
* Candidates must possess a valid driver's license and maintain a clean driving record.

**Other Qualifications**

* Preferred skills \- experience using Salesforce and Microsoft Office applications including Excel, Word, and Outlook.
* Problem solving skills \- strong analytical and critical thinking skills to identify problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Customer service \- responds promptly to requests for assistance and strives to continually improve service.
* Planning/organizing \- the ability to manage multiple tasks to ensure that assignments are completed in a timely and productive manner.
* Quality control/Attention to detail \- demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness; monitors own work to ensure quality and applies feedback to improve performance.
* Adaptability \- adapts to changes in the work environment and is able to deal with frequent change, delays, or unexpected events.
* Dependability \- consistently at work and on time, follows instructions, takes responsibility for own actions, responds to management direction.
* Efficiency \- the ability to visit required number of weekly visits in a timely manner without sacrificing quality.
* Teamwork \- Able to work in team environment.
* Communication \- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Education of Aria Care Partners’ mission \& services to potential facilities.
* Currently possess a life/health insurance license or the ability to successfully complete the licensing course and exam.
* Territory management – the ability to plan weekly travel throughout the state to visit with nursing home staff and residents.
* Daily Travel with potential for 75% overnight stay.

**Why Should You Apply?**

* Ability to work for a company that cares and makes a difference.
* You enjoy feeling challenged and driven to exceed goals

**The Pay**

* Competitive Base Pay \+ bonus
* Mileage reimbursement

**Benefits**


We offer a comprehensive benefit package for you and your family, including:

* PTO and Paid Holidays for FT Employees
* 401k Retirement Plan with Company Match
* Insurance programs including medical, dental, vision, company match for your HSA, FSA, company\-paid EAP, and life and disability insurance, and more.

**Working at Aria Matters!**

Victory Live is a private equity backed technology company aimed at maximizing distribution and yield for live event ticket inventory. new_jobs.title: Territory Sales Representative - Entry Level / Full Time
new_jobs.description:
Territory Sales Representative – Entry Level / Full Time
  
  

Atlanta GA
  
  

Break Into Pharmaceutical Sales with Pivya® at ImpactBio supporting Alembic Therapeutics
  
  

Do you have work experience that demonstrates drive, energy, and transferable skills that will lead to being a strong salesperson?
  
If you are looking to launch a career in pharmaceutical sales, this is your opportunity!
  
  

Alembic Therapeutics, in partnership with ImpactBio, is launching Pivya®, an FDA\-approved oral antibiotic for uncomplicated urinary tract infections (uUTIs). With over 40 years of success in Sweden, Pivya® is now entering the U.S. market—and we’re building a high\-performance sales team to support this launch.
  
  

As a Territory Sales Representative, you don’t need prior pharmaceutical sales experience—we’re looking for motivated, coachable individuals who are eager to learn, follow a proven sales model, and build a long\-term career in the industry. You’ll receive the training, tools, and mentorship needed to succeed while gaining real\-world experience calling on healthcare providers.
  
  

This full\-time role is with ImpactBio, a premier commercial partner in Life Sciences, with the potential to transition to Alembic Therapeutics based on strong performance.
  
View Openings \& Apply Here Job Openings \- ImpactBio
  
  

Why This Role Matters
  
  

This is more than a sales job—it’s a career entry point into pharmaceutical sales. You’ll be part of a national product launch, gaining experience in a highly competitive industry while developing the skills and discipline needed to grow your career.
  
  

**We’re looking for individuals who are:**  

* Hungry to succeed
* Open to coaching and feedback
* Willing to follow a structured plan
* Ready to put in the work to build something meaningful


If that sounds like you, we’ll teach you the rest.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Promote Pivya® to healthcare providers within your assigned territory
* Learn and execute a structured sales process and messaging strategy
* Build relationships with physicians, nurses, and office staff
* Consistently apply training and coaching in the field
* Develop and execute territory plans to achieve sales goals
* Provide timely updates, insights, and field feedback to leadership
* Maintain full compliance with all company and industry regulations


What We’re Looking For
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree required
* 1–3 years of experience meeting or exceeding goals/metrics (some sales experience would be helpful, B2B sales, Pharma sales, outside sales, customer facing)
* A strong desire to break into pharmaceutical or healthcare sales
* Proven work ethic and demonstrated a track record of going above and beyond to succeed
* Coachability—someone who takes direction well and applies feedback quickly
* High level of motivation, resilience, and accountability
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work independently while following a defined sales plan
* Willingness to travel extensively within territory
* Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record


Pharmaceutical experience is not required—drive, attitude, and willingness to learn are.
  
  

What We Offer
  
  

* Competitive base salary with a generous performance\-based incentive plan
* Comprehensive Medical, Dental \& Vision coverage
* Car allowance \& mileage reimbursement
* 401K plan with company match
* Paid time off and holidays
* Structured training program designed to help you break into and succeed in pharmaceutical sales
* Ongoing mentorship and field coaching
* A clear path for career growth and advancement
* The chance to be part of a major U.S. product launch


About Alembic Therapeutics
  
  

Alembic Therapeutics LLC, a U.S. subsidiary of Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc., is committed to delivering high\-quality, patient\-focused branded pharmaceuticals. Our mission is to bring innovative, reliable medicines to the U.S. market while upholding the highest standards of safety, efficacy, and quality.
  
  

About ImpactBio
  
  

At ImpactBio, we build and launch commercial teams with a focus on performance, development, and long\-term success. We’re known for investing in our people and creating opportunities for driven individuals to grow into high\-performing professionals in the life sciences industry.
  
  

The annual base salary for this position is $65,000\. Compensation is aligned with the position’s scope and internal pay structure.
  
  

Apply Now
  
  

View Openings \& Apply Here Job Openings \- ImpactBio
  
  

ImpactBio is an affirmative action/equal opportunity employer (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)
  
  

We appreciate your interest in our company, however; only candidates meeting qualifications will be considered.

Nextar Telecom

Full Time  

**Team Nextar, an authorized retailer for Metro by T\-Mobile with over 260 locations nationwide**, is looking for driven, passionate, and outgoing individuals to join our **Metro by T\-Mobile Sales Team**. As a **Metro by T\-Mobile Wireless Retail Sales Associate** for Team Nextar, you will be working directly with our customers, educating them on the **Metro by T\-Mobile** Products and Services we offer and guiding them through the selection and sales process. The ideal candidate will have experience in retail environments, understand how to do outbound activities to drive customers into our locations, are driven by goals and accomplishments, and are focused on delivering an exceptional customer experience to earn repeat business and have a desire to earn **LOTS OF MONEY!**  

**As a Metro by T\-Mobile Wireless Retail Sales Associate for Nextar Telecom, you will enjoy some great perks:**  

* Strong base\-pay and an unprecedented un\-capped sales bonus schedule designed to reward you for your selling efforts.
* Flexible Work Schedule.
* Employee Health Plan.
* Personal Time Off.
* Great and fun working atmosphere.
* Significant opportunities to grow in our company.
* Win prizes and trips through various sales contests throughout the year.

  

**As a Metro by T\-Mobile Wireless Retail Sales Associate for Team Nextar** will be **responsible for:**  

* Creating the ideal customer experience for each customer, every day.
* Assisting new and existing customers throughout the sales process.
* Educating our customers on all Metro by T\-Mobile Products and Services we offer.
* Produce sufficient sales to meet and exceed company and location production standards.
* Handle all customer situations as trained to completely satisfy customers’ needs.
* Assist the Store Manager in tasks assigned to you personally or the team.
* Complete all required trainings as directed by Metro by T\-Mobile and Team Nextar.
* Set an example of personal and professional conduct for employees and others.

  

**Team Nextar is looking for candidates with the following experiences, skills, and qualifications:**  

* 1 year or more experience in a similar role in a retail or a customer facing environment, preferably with Metro by T\-Mobile.
* Proof of achievement in prior sales and customer service roles
* Enthusiasm for retail, wireless technology and products and customer service.
* Ability to travel to our various locations in your market as business needs dictate.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Bilingual Spanish may be required based on location
* Be self\-motivated and goal oriented
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Able to work evenings, weekends, and holidays with a flexible schedule.
* Must be 18 years of age or older and able to provide proof of work eligibility in the US.

  

  

**About Nextar Telecom**
